title: Ruski vojni avioni izazvali paniku na južnokorejskom ostrvu
Russian military planes cause panic on a South Korean island
body: Stanovnici južnokorejskog ostrva Ulleungdo dobili su upozorenje da se sklone, jer su se blizu ostrva pojavili ruski vojni avioni.
Residents of the South Korean island of Ulleungdo received a warning to take shelter, because Russian military planes appeared near the island.
Ostrvo se nalazi oko 120 kilometara od istočne obale Južne Koreje.
The island lies about 120 kilometres from the east coast of South Korea.
Južnokorejska vojska kaže da su avioni ušli u zonu protivzračne identifikacije.
The South Korean military says that the planes entered the air defence identification zone.
Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova poslalo je u 7:52 hitnu poruku za oko 8.700 stanovnika.
At 7:52 the Ministry of the Interior sent an emergency message to about 8,700 residents.
Televizijski program je prekinut, a ljudima je rečeno da se spreme za odlazak u skloništa.
The TV programme was interrupted, and people were told to get ready to go to shelters.
Upozorenje je ukinuto već u 7:55, ali su na ostrvu svirale sirene.
The warning was lifted already at 7:55, but sirens sounded on the island.
Južnokorejsko zrakoplovstvo poslalo je svoje borbene avione.
The South Korean air force sent up its fighter jets.
Jedan građevinski radnik rekao je da je odmah pobjegao s gradilišta kada je dobio poruku.
One construction worker said that he immediately ran from the building site when he got the message.
Lokalne vlasti su kasnije priznale da su greškom poslale i poruku o sjevernokorejskom avionu.
Local authorities later admitted that they had by mistake also sent a message about a North Korean plane.
Ministarstvo odbrane planira pozvati ruskog vojnog atašea i uložiti oštar protest.
The Ministry of Defence plans to summon the Russian military attaché and lodge a strong protest.

title: U akciji protiv narkokartela u Meksiku poginulo 20 osoba
20 people killed in an operation against a drug cartel in Mexico
body: Meksička vojska izvela je u gradu Guasave akciju hvatanja vođe kartela Fausta Isidra Meze Floresa.
The Mexican army carried out an operation in the town of Guasave to capture cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.
On je poznat kao El Chapo Isidro, a akcija je počela 20. novembra navečer.
He is known as El Chapo Isidro, and the operation began on the evening of 20 November.
U sukobu je poginulo 20 osoba, među njima 16 članova kriminalne grupe i 4 vojnika.
20 people were killed in the clash, among them 16 members of the criminal group and 4 soldiers.
Ministar odbrane Ricardo Trevilla Trejo rekao je da je ranjeno još 10 vojnika.
Defence Minister Ricardo Trevilla Trejo said that another 10 soldiers were wounded.
U akciji su učestvovali pripadnici vojske i Nacionalne garde, njih 361, uz više helikoptera.
361 members of the army and the National Guard took part in the operation, along with several helicopters.
Uhapšeno je 16 osoba, a policija je zaplijenila 28 komada oružja.
16 people were arrested, and the police seized 28 weapons.
Među uhapšenima su i dva rođaka Meze Floresa, koji su važni u organizaciji.
Among those arrested are also two relatives of Meza Flores, who are important in the organisation.
Trevilla je rekao da je Meksiko 3 mjeseca razmjenjivao informacije sa SAD-om.
Trevilla said that Mexico had exchanged information with the US for 3 months.
FBI ga je još u februaru 2025. godine stavio na listu 10 najtraženijih bjegunaca.
Back in February 2025 the FBI put him on its list of the 10 most wanted fugitives.
U SAD-u ga terete za trgovinu kokainom, metamfetaminom i fentanilom.
In the US he is charged with trafficking cocaine, methamphetamine and fentanyl.

title: Tramvaji jutros ne voze do Baščaršije zbog kvara
Trams not running to Baščaršija this morning because of a breakdown
body: Tramvaji u Sarajevu jutros ne voze na dionici od Čengić Vile do Baščaršije.
Trams in Sarajevo are not running this morning on the section from Čengić Vila to Baščaršija.
Saobraćaj radi samo na dijelu linije od Ilidže do Čengić Vile.
Service is running only on the part of the line from Ilidža to Čengić Vila.
Javno preduzeće GRAS potvrdilo je da se jedan tramvaj pokvario kod Kampusa Univerziteta u Sarajevu.
The public company GRAS confirmed that one tram broke down near the University of Sarajevo Campus.
Zbog kvara tramvaji ne mogu ići prema centru grada.
Because of the breakdown, trams cannot go towards the city centre.
Na stajalištima su se zato skupile velike gužve, a putnici traže drugi prevoz.
Large crowds have therefore gathered at the stops, and passengers are looking for other transport.
Mnogi žele stići od Čengić Vile do Baščaršije autobusom.
Many want to get from Čengić Vila to Baščaršija by bus.
Putnici u Sarajevu i inače ujutro često dugo čekaju na tramvaj.
Passengers in Sarajevo often wait a long time for a tram in the mornings anyway.
Gužve su veće jer nema dovoljno tramvaja, iako je linija nedavno produžena do Hrasnice.
The crowds are bigger because there are not enough trams, although the line was recently extended to Hrasnica.
Zbog toga putnici često ne mogu ući u prvi tramvaj koji dođe.
Because of that, passengers often cannot get on the first tram that comes.

title: Jessica Alba mora bivšem suprugu platiti pola miliona dolara
Jessica Alba must pay her ex-husband half a million dollars
body: Sud u Los Angelesu naredio je glumici Jessici Albi da bivšem suprugu Cashu Warrenu plati 577.481 dolar.
A court in Los Angeles has ordered actress Jessica Alba to pay her ex-husband Cash Warren 577,481 dollars.
Novac dolazi iz penzijskog fonda njene kompanije HonorBar.
The money comes from the pension fund of her company HonorBar.
Odluka je donesena u petak, 20. novembra, a objavio ju je portal Page Six.
The decision was made on Friday, 20 November, and the portal Page Six reported it.
Iznos se može promijeniti ako se vrijednost investicija do isplate poveća ili smanji.
The amount can change if the value of the investments rises or falls before the payment.
Warren novac može uzeti odjednom ili ga prebaciti u drugi penzijski fond.
Warren can take the money at once or move it to another pension fund.
Alba mu je ranije pristala platiti i 3 miliona dolara, u dvije rate po 1,5 miliona.
Alba had earlier also agreed to pay him 3 million dollars, in two instalments of 1.5 million each.
Warren dobija i polovinu njene zarade od reprize serija snimljenih tokom braka.
Warren also receives half of her earnings from reruns of series filmed during the marriage.
Alba i Warren upoznali su se 2004. godine na snimanju filma Fantastična četvorka.
Alba and Warren met in 2004 while filming the movie Fantastic Four.
Vjenčali su se 2008. godine, a razišli su se u decembru 2024. godine nakon 16 godina braka.
They married in 2008, and they separated in December 2024 after 16 years of marriage.
Imaju troje djece, o kojima brinu zajedno.
They have three children, whom they look after together.

title: Pucketanje prstiju ne izaziva artritis, pokazuju istraživanja
Cracking your knuckles does not cause arthritis, research shows
body: Mnogi ljudi vjeruju da pucketanje prstiju izaziva artritis, odnosno upalu zglobova.
Many people believe that cracking your knuckles causes arthritis, that is, inflammation of the joints.
Istraživanja pokazuju da to nije tačno, a prste redovno pucketa 25 do 45 posto ljudi.
Research shows that this is not true, and 25 to 45 percent of people crack their knuckles regularly.
Jedan američki ljekar je to provjeravao na sebi čak 50 godina.
One American doctor checked this on himself for as many as 50 years.
Donald Unger je najmanje dva puta dnevno pucketao prste lijeve ruke, a desnu nije.
Donald Unger cracked the knuckles of his left hand at least twice a day, but not his right.
Godine 1998. napisao je da nema artritisa ni na jednoj ruci.
In 1998 he wrote that there was no arthritis in either hand.
Za ovaj eksperiment dobio je 2009. godine šaljivu nagradu Ig Nobel.
For this experiment he received the humorous Ig Nobel prize in 2009.
Studija iz 2011. godine s 215 ljudi pokazala je da artritis nije češći kod onih koji pucketaju prstima.
A 2011 study with 215 people showed that arthritis is not more common among those who crack their knuckles.
Istraživači iz Kanade otkrili su 2015. godine da zvuk nastaje kada se u tečnosti u zglobu stvori šupljina s plinom.
Researchers from Canada discovered in 2015 that the sound occurs when a cavity with gas forms in the fluid in the joint.
Ljekari ipak kažu da pucketanje ne bi trebalo boljeti.
Doctors still say that cracking should not hurt.
Ako se pojave bol, otok ili slabiji stisak, treba otići ljekaru.
If pain, swelling or a weaker grip appear, you should go to a doctor.

title: Jutros moguća poledica na cestama i magla u BiH
Possible black ice on roads and fog in BiH this morning
body: Vozači u Bosni i Hercegovini jutros moraju biti oprezni, jer su temperature niske.
Drivers in Bosnia and Herzegovina must be careful this morning, because temperatures are low.
Na svim vlažnim dionicama cesta moguća je poledica, odnosno tanak sloj leda.
On all wet sections of road black ice is possible, that is, a thin layer of ice.
U sjeverozapadnim dijelovima zemlje magla mjestimično smanjuje vidljivost.
In the north-western parts of the country fog reduces visibility in places.
U Sarajevu je jutros -3 stepena, a danas se očekuje do 6 stepeni.
In Sarajevo it is -3 degrees this morning, and up to 6 degrees is expected today.
Sutra bi temperatura mogla biti od 0 do 10 stepeni.
Tomorrow the temperature could be from 0 to 10 degrees.
Zbog niskih temperatura na snazi je žuto upozorenje.
Because of the low temperatures a yellow warning is in force.
Na autoputu između Zenice jug i Zenice sjever saobraćaj je spor zbog radova kod tunela Klopče.
On the motorway between Zenica south and Zenica north traffic is slow because of works near the Klopče tunnel.
Radovi se izvode i na mnogim drugim cestama, pa se na nekim mjestima vozi jednom trakom.
Works are also being carried out on many other roads, so in some places traffic uses one lane.
Na cesti od Jablanice do Blidinja mogu voziti samo vozila do 3,5 tone.
On the road from Jablanica to Blidinje only vehicles up to 3.5 tonnes may drive.
Prema podacima BIHAMK-a, na graničnim prijelazima nema dugog čekanja za automobile.
According to BIHAMK data, there are no long waits for cars at border crossings.

title: Američki kongresmen Jimmy Gomez podnosi ostavku
US congressman Jimmy Gomez is resigning
body: Američki kongresmen Jimmy Gomez iz Kalifornije napustit će Predstavnički dom 1. decembra.
US congressman Jimmy Gomez from California will leave the House of Representatives on 1 December.
Odluku je objavio nakon što je etički odbor Kongresa našao dokaze o seksualnom uznemiravanju.
He announced the decision after the congressional ethics committee found evidence of sexual harassment.
Gomez ima 51 godinu i član je Demokratske stranke.
Gomez is 51 years old and is a member of the Democratic Party.
U izvještaju odbora piše da je imao neželjene seksualne prijedloge prema jednoj uposlenici Kongresa.
The committee's report says that he made unwanted sexual advances towards a female employee of Congress.
Žena je rekla da se to dogodilo dva puta, a odbor piše da je zbog toga napustila posao.
The woman said that it happened twice, and the committee writes that she left her job because of it.
Istraga je počela u augustu 2025. godine.
The investigation began in August 2025.
Gomez je predstavljao dio Los Angelesa pet mandata.
Gomez represented part of Los Angeles for five terms.
U pisanoj izjavi Gomez je rekao da se ne slaže s nalazima odbora.
In a written statement Gomez said that he does not agree with the committee's findings.
Ipak, rekao je da preuzima punu odgovornost za lične greške i da nema drugog izbora.
Still, he said that he takes full responsibility for personal mistakes and that he has no other choice.
On je ovog mjeseca već izgubio stranačke izbore za svoje mjesto, i to za oko 25 procentnih poena.
This month he had already lost the party election for his seat, by about 25 percentage points.

title: Kapetan broda Costa Concordia izašao iz zatvora
Captain of the Costa Concordia ship leaves prison
body: Francesco Schettino, bivši kapetan broda Costa Concordia, izašao je 20. novembra iz zatvora Rebibbia u Rimu.
Francesco Schettino, the former captain of the Costa Concordia ship, left Rebibbia prison in Rome on 20 November.
Brod je u januaru 2012. godine udario u stijene kod ostrva Giglio, a u nesreći su poginule 32 osobe.
In January 2012 the ship hit rocks near the island of Giglio, and 32 people died in the accident.
Sud u Rimu odlučio je da ostatak kazne služi uz nadzor socijalne službe.
A court in Rome decided that he will serve the rest of his sentence under the supervision of social services.
Schettino ima 66 godina i nije potpuno slobodan, jer se mora vratiti u zatvor ako prekrši pravila.
Schettino is 66 years old and is not completely free, because he must return to prison if he breaks the rules.
On će osam sati dnevno raditi za privatnog poslodavca u regiji Kampanija i volontirati.
He will work eight hours a day for a private employer in the Campania region and do volunteer work.
Od 22 do 6 sati mora biti kod kuće.
From 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. he must be at home.
Zbog dobrog ponašanja kazna mu se završava u julu 2030. godine, oko 2 godine ranije nego što je planirano.
Because of good behaviour his sentence ends in July 2030, about 2 years earlier than planned.
Sud u Grossetu osudio ga je 2015. godine na 16 godina zatvora, između ostalog zato što je napustio brod.
A court in Grosseto sentenced him in 2015 to 16 years in prison, among other things because he abandoned the ship.
U zatvor je otišao 2017. godine, a dosad je odslužio oko 9 i po godina kazne.
He went to prison in 2017, and so far he has served about 9 and a half years of the sentence.
Njegova advokatica rekla je da je njegovo ponašanje u zatvoru bilo izuzetno pozitivno.
His lawyer said that his behaviour in prison was extremely positive.

title: NATO upozorava Rusiju zbog navodnog nuklearnog satelita
NATO warns Russia over an alleged nuclear satellite
body: Generalni sekretar NATO-a Mark Rutte rekao je u Berlinu da će savez braniti svoju teritoriju i u svemiru.
NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said in Berlin that the alliance will defend its territory in space as well.
Njegova izjava dolazi nakon izvještaja njemačkih medija da Rusija sprema lansiranje satelita s nuklearnim oružjem.
His statement comes after German media reports that Russia is preparing to launch a satellite with a nuclear weapon.
Prema tim izvještajima, satelit bi mogao biti lansiran u narednih 60 dana.
According to those reports, the satellite could be launched in the next 60 days.
Mediji NDR, WDR i Süddeutsche Zeitung pišu da se satelit zove Sputnik-S i da nosi nuklearnu bojevu glavu.
The media outlets NDR, WDR and Süddeutsche Zeitung write that the satellite is called Sputnik-S and carries a nuclear warhead.
Takav satelit bi mogao ometati ili uništiti druge satelite, koji su važni za komunikaciju i nadzor.
Such a satellite could jam or destroy other satellites, which are important for communication and surveillance.
Rutte je rekao da NATO ima više načina da odgovori i da stalno jača svoju odbranu.
Rutte said that NATO has several ways to respond and that it is constantly strengthening its defence.
Njemački kancelar Friedrich Merz nije potvrdio ove informacije, ali je rekao da su šokantne.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz did not confirm this information, but he said that it is shocking.
Šef Evropske svemirske agencije Josef Aschbacher rekao je da bi nuklearno oružje u svemiru bilo najgori mogući scenarij.
The head of the European Space Agency, Josef Aschbacher, said that nuclear weapons in space would be the worst possible scenario.
Kremlj je odbacio ove tvrdnje, a ruska ambasada u Berlinu govori o propagandi.
The Kremlin rejected these claims, and the Russian embassy in Berlin speaks of propaganda.
Rusija je potpisala sporazum iz 1967. godine, koji zabranjuje oružje za masovno uništenje u orbiti.
Russia signed a 1967 treaty which bans weapons of mass destruction in orbit.

title: Ustavni sud objasnio zašto je poništio veto Željke Cvijanović
Constitutional Court explains why it annulled Željka Cvijanović's veto
body: Ustavni sud BiH objavio je u ponedjeljak obrazloženje odluke o vetu Željke Cvijanović.
The Constitutional Court of BiH published on Monday the reasoning behind its decision on Željka Cvijanović's veto.
Sud je veto poništio još 19. novembra, a odluku je podržalo 7 sudija.
The court annulled the veto back on 19 November, and 7 judges supported the decision.
Potpredsjednica suda Valerija Galić dala je izjavu o neslaganju.
The court's vice-president, Valerija Galić, gave a dissenting statement.
Predsjedništvo BiH je 29. juna imenovalo članove Komisije za očuvanje nacionalnih spomenika.
On 29 June the BiH Presidency appointed the members of the Commission to Preserve National Monuments.
Za odluku su glasali Denis Bećirović i Željko Komšić, dok je Cvijanović bila protiv.
Denis Bećirović and Željko Komšić voted for the decision, while Cvijanović was against.
Ona je zatim rekla da je odluka štetna za vitalni interes Republike Srpske, a Narodna skupština RS-a to je potvrdila 7. jula.
She then said the decision was harmful to the vital interest of Republika Srpska, and the RS National Assembly confirmed this on 7 July.
Cvijanović je tvrdila da je to pitanje vanjske politike, jer dva člana Komisije predlaže UNESCO.
Cvijanović claimed it was a foreign policy question, because UNESCO proposes two members of the Commission.
Sud je rekao da je imenovanje Komisije kadrovska odluka o domaćoj instituciji, a ne vanjska politika.
The court said the appointment of the Commission is a personnel decision about a domestic institution, not foreign policy.
Komisija se finansira iz državnog budžeta, a svih 5 članova imenuje Predsjedništvo.
The Commission is funded from the state budget, and the Presidency appoints all 5 members.
Sud je dodao da član Predsjedništva ne može staviti veto na svaku odluku, nego samo na neka pitanja.
The court added that a Presidency member cannot veto every decision, but only certain questions.
Zato imenovanje članova Komisije ostaje na snazi.
That is why the appointment of the Commission's members remains in force.

title: Sud u Sarajevu raspisao potjernicu za dvojicom muškaraca
Sarajevo court issues a warrant for two men
body: Kantonalni sud u Sarajevu raspisao je potjernicu za Tarikom Panjetom i Davudom Puškićem.
The Cantonal Court in Sarajevo has issued a warrant for Tarik Panjeta and Davud Puškić.
Potjernica je nalog policiji da traži i uhapsi osobu.
A warrant is an order to the police to search for and arrest a person.
Glasnogovornik suda Jakov Avram rekao je da se sumnjiče za razbojništvo.
Court spokesman Jakov Avram said they are suspected of robbery.
Slučaj je povezan s akcijom "Pirat", koju je policija prošle sedmice provela u Sarajevu.
The case is linked to the operation "Pirat", which the police carried out in Sarajevo last week.
Policija je tada u jednom stanu kod Narodnog pozorišta uhapsila mladića rođenog 1998. godine.
The police then arrested a young man born in 1998 in a flat near the National Theatre.
U istoj akciji uhapšena su još dvojica muškaraca, rođena 2004. i 1998. godine.
In the same operation two more men were arrested, born in 2004 and 1998.
Panjeta i Puškić bježe od policije već nekoliko dana.
Panjeta and Puškić have been running from the police for several days.
Puškić je u augustu bio u pritvoru mjesec dana zbog pucnjave u jednom lokalu na Baščaršiji.
In August Puškić was in custody for a month because of a shooting in a bar in Baščaršija.
Protiv Panjete je 2021. godine potvrđena optužnica zbog prodaje droge.
In 2021 an indictment against Panjeta was confirmed for selling drugs.
Bio je optužen i zbog toga što je nezakonito imao oružje.
He was also charged because he illegally had a weapon.

title: Šapić ostaje gradonačelnik Beograda, smjena nije uspjela
Šapić stays mayor of Belgrade, removal fails
body: Aleksandar Šapić ostaje gradonačelnik Beograda, jer opozicija nije imala dovoljno glasova za smjenu.
Aleksandar Šapić remains mayor of Belgrade, because the opposition did not have enough votes to remove him.
U Skupštini grada za smjenu je glasalo 34 odbornika.
In the City Assembly 34 councillors voted for his removal.
Bilo je potrebno najmanje 56 glasova od ukupno 110.
At least 56 votes out of 110 in total were needed.
Glasanje je bilo tajno, a jedan odbornik glasao je protiv smjene.
The vote was secret, and one councillor voted against the removal.
Smjenu je pokrenuo pokret "Kreni-promeni" nakon incidenta 28. septembra.
The movement "Kreni-promeni" started the removal after an incident on 28 September.
Šapić je optužen da je tada napao odbornicu Tatjanu Mićić i slomio joj nos.
Šapić is accused of attacking councillor Tatjana Mićić and breaking her nose at that time.
Vlast tvrdi da za to nema dokaza.
The ruling parties claim there is no evidence for this.
Tužilaštvo je prošle sedmice tražilo da Šapić dobije najmanje 3 godine zatvora.
Last week the prosecution asked that Šapić get at least 3 years in prison.
Aleksandar Mirković iz vladajuće grupe rekao je da će Šapić na sudu dokazati da je nevin.
Aleksandar Mirković from the ruling group said that Šapić will prove in court that he is innocent.
Ovo je bio drugi pokušaj smjene, jer sjednica 13. oktobra nije održana.
This was the second attempt at removal, because the session on 13 October was not held.
Tada vladajući odbornici nisu došli, pa nije bilo kvoruma.
At that time the ruling councillors did not come, so there was no quorum.

title: Nova Skupština SBK počela s radom, Matišić ponovo predsjedavajući
New Central Bosnia Assembly starts work, Matišić chairman again
body: Skupština Srednjobosanskog kantona konstituisana je u ponedjeljak u Travniku.
The Assembly of Central Bosnia Canton was constituted on Monday in Travnik.
Dražen Matišić iz HDZ-a BiH ponovo je izabran za predsjedavajućeg, i to na 4 godine.
Dražen Matišić of HDZ BiH was again elected chairman, for 4 years.
Njegovi zamjenici su Salkan Merdžanić iz SDA i Zorana Kunovac iz SDP-a.
His deputies are Salkan Merdžanić of the SDA and Zorana Kunovac of the SDP.
Predsjednik CIK-a Jovan Kalaba predao je uvjerenja za 30 zastupnika, koji su zatim položili zakletvu.
The president of the Central Election Commission, Jovan Kalaba, handed certificates to 30 MPs, who then took the oath.
Četiri zastupnika su zamrznula mandate, pa su na njihova mjesta došla nova imena.
Four MPs froze their mandates, so new names took their places.
Za izbor nove vlade kantona potrebno je 20 glasova, odnosno dvije trećine.
Electing a new cantonal government requires 20 votes, that is two thirds.
SDA ima 11 zastupnika, a koalicija oko HDZ-a BiH ima 8, što je ukupno 19.
The SDA has 11 MPs and the coalition around HDZ BiH has 8, which is 19 in total.
To znači da im za vladu nedostaje jedan glas.
That means they are one vote short for a government.
Matišić je rekao da Skupština treba biti mjesto poštovanja i korektnog političkog dijaloga.
Matišić said the Assembly should be a place of respect and proper political dialogue.
Sjednica će se nastaviti kada CIK potvrdi liste delegata za Dom naroda FBiH.
The session will continue when the Central Election Commission confirms the lists of delegates for the FBiH House of Peoples.

title: Trump tražio od Nvidije da Huanga vrati na čelo
Trump asked Nvidia to bring Huang back to the top
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump uključio se telefonom u sjednicu odbora direktora Nvidije.
US President Donald Trump joined a meeting of Nvidia's board of directors by phone.
Prema portalu Semafor, tražio je da Jensen Huang ponovo postane direktor kompanije.
According to the Semafor portal, he asked that Jensen Huang become the company's director again.
Nekoliko sati kasnije odbor je jednoglasno vratio Huanga na mjesto predsjednika i direktora.
A few hours later the board unanimously returned Huang to the position of president and director.
Huang je otišao 12. novembra, nakon što su otkrivene njegove vanbračne veze.
Huang left on 12 November, after his extramarital affairs were revealed.
Jedna od tih žena je osumnjičena da je kineska špijunka.
One of those women is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
Odbor je sada rekao da je od najvišeg nivoa vlasti u SAD-u dobio garanciju da Huang nije opasnost za nacionalnu sigurnost.
The board now said it had received a guarantee from the highest level of the US government that Huang is not a danger to national security.
Nakon vijesti su dionice Nvidije porasle za oko 30 posto.
After the news, Nvidia's shares rose by about 30 percent.
Trump je na mreži Truth Social napisao da je odluka ispravna i da Huanga lično poznaje.
Trump wrote on the Truth Social network that the decision was right and that he knows Huang personally.
Rekao je da vlada nema dokaza da je Huang uradio nešto nezakonito.
He said the government has no evidence that Huang did anything illegal.
Ipak je pozvao kompaniju da nastavi istragu o poštivanju pravila za izvoz.
Still, he called on the company to continue the investigation into compliance with export rules.
Predsjednik odbora je još 17. novembra rekao da Huang neće biti vraćen.
As late as 17 November the board chairman had said Huang would not be brought back.

title: Bakić se smiješi kameri, a Vučić ga mrko gleda
Bakić smiles at the camera, while Vučić glares at him
body: U Skupštini Srbije u ponedjeljak su održane konsultacije kod predsjednika Skupštine Aleksandra Čupića.
Consultations with the Speaker of the Assembly, Aleksandar Čupić, were held in the Serbian Assembly on Monday.
Jedan do drugog sjedili su Jovo Bakić iz Studentske liste i Aleksandar Vučić.
Jovo Bakić from the Student List and Aleksandar Vučić sat next to each other.
Na snimku se vidi kako se Bakić smiješi i maše kameri, a Vučić ga ozbiljno gleda.
The video shows Bakić smiling and waving at the camera, while Vučić looks at him seriously.
Snimak je objavljen na YouTube kanalu Skupštine Srbije.
The video was published on the Serbian Assembly's YouTube channel.
Razgovaralo se o izboru članova skupštinskih odbora i delegacija u međunarodnim institucijama.
They talked about choosing members of assembly committees and delegations to international institutions.
Bakić je došao sa zastupnikom Mariom Reljanovićem, a Vučić sa svojim zamjenikom Milenkom Jovanovim.
Bakić came with MP Mario Reljanović, and Vučić with his deputy Milenko Jovanov.
Nakon sastanka Vučić je rekao da njegovi zastupnici vjerovatno neće raditi u odborima.
After the meeting Vučić said that his MPs will probably not work in the committees.
Konačna odluka bit će donesena sutra, kada se nastavlja konstitutivna sjednica.
The final decision will be made tomorrow, when the constitutive session continues.
Bakić je profesor na Filozofskom fakultetu u Beogradu i već godinama kritikuje Vučićevu vlast.
Bakić is a professor at the Faculty of Philosophy in Belgrade and has criticised Vučić's government for years.
Njih dvojica su se u tri dana sjednice više puta oštro svađali.
The two of them argued sharply several times during the three days of the session.

title: Kina spremna za let koji vodi prvog stranca na svoju stanicu
China ready for a flight taking the first foreigner to its station
body: Kina je završila pripreme za lansiranje svemirske letjelice Shenzhou-24.
China has finished preparations for the launch of the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft.
Prema kineskoj televiziji CCTV, spremna je i svemirska stanica Tiangong.
According to Chinese television CCTV, the Tiangong space station is also ready.
Na ovaj let ide i prvi strani astronaut, koji dolazi iz Pakistana.
The first foreign astronaut, who comes from Pakistan, is also going on this flight.
Letjelica i raketa prošle sedmice su prebačene na lansirno mjesto u centru Jiuquan na sjeverozapadu Kine.
The spacecraft and rocket were moved last week to the launch site at the Jiuquan centre in north-west China.
U subotu je održana generalna proba svih sistema, ali datum lansiranja još nije objavljen.
A full rehearsal of all systems was held on Saturday, but the launch date has not been announced yet.
Pakistanski astronaut će kratko ostati u orbiti i vratit će se na Zemlju letjelicom Shenzhou-23.
The Pakistani astronaut will stay in orbit for a short time and will return to Earth on the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft.
To će biti prvi zajednički let kineskih i stranih astronauta u kineskom programu.
It will be the first joint flight of Chinese and foreign astronauts in the Chinese programme.
Posada koja je sada na stanici pripremila je prostor, zalihe i mjesta za spavanje.
The crew now on the station prepared the space, supplies and sleeping places.
Sistem za održavanje života podešen je tako da na stanici istovremeno može biti 6 ljudi.
The life-support system was adjusted so that 6 people can be on the station at the same time.
Nakon lansiranja, letjelica će se spojiti s glavnim modulom stanice.
After the launch, the spacecraft will dock with the station's main module.

title: Glumica Martina Stjepanović Meter o majčinoj pomoći nakon poroda
Actress Martina Stjepanović Meter on her mother's help after giving birth
body: Hrvatska glumica Martina Stjepanović Meter govorila je o majčinstvu i odnosu sa svojim roditeljima.
Croatian actress Martina Stjepanović Meter spoke about motherhood and her relationship with her parents.
Bila je gošća u novoj epizodi podcasta "Nema labavo".
She was a guest in a new episode of the podcast "Nema labavo".
Rekla je da joj je majka mnogo pomogla nakon poroda.
She said her mother helped her a lot after giving birth.
Majka je prve dvije sedmice bila s njom i pomagala joj da se navikne na novu ulogu.
For the first two weeks her mother was with her and helped her get used to the new role.
Kuhala je domaća jela, pomagala u kući i pazila kako se Martina osjeća.
She cooked home-made meals, helped around the house and watched how Martina was feeling.
Glumica kaže da je najvažnije bilo to što je mogla biti blizu svoje bebe.
The actress says the most important thing was that she could be close to her baby.
"I mami treba mama", rekla je Martina.
"Even a mum needs a mum", Martina said.
Kaže da joj je emocionalna podrška značila više od praktične pomoći, jer je važno da te neko razumije i primijeti.
She says emotional support meant more to her than practical help, because it is important that someone understands and notices you.
Kada je postala majka, bolje je razumjela ljubav svojih roditelja.
When she became a mother, she understood her parents' love better.
Sjeća se da je kao tinejdžerka mislila da je roditelji ne razumiju i da je lupala vratima.
She remembers that as a teenager she thought her parents did not understand her and that she slammed doors.
Danas vidi da je njihova ljubav bila bezuslovna i jaka.
Today she sees that their love was unconditional and strong.

title: Duge jutarnje dremke kod starijih povezane s većim rizikom
Long morning naps in older people linked to higher risk
body: Novo američko istraživanje pokazuje da stariji ljudi koji duže i češće drijemaju imaju veći rizik od smrti.
A new American study shows that older people who nap longer and more often have a higher risk of death.
Naučnici su pratili 1.338 osoba i do 19 godina.
The scientists followed 1,338 people for up to 19 years.
Studija je objavljena u časopisu JAMA Network Open.
The study was published in the journal JAMA Network Open.
Učesnici su od 2005. godine 10 dana nosili uređaj na ruci koji je bilježio san i kretanje.
From 2005 the participants wore a device on their wrist for 10 days that recorded sleep and movement.
Svaki dodatni sat dremanja dnevno bio je povezan s oko 13 posto većim rizikom.
Every extra hour of napping a day was linked to about 13 percent higher risk.
Svaka dodatna dremka povećavala je rizik za oko 7 posto.
Every extra nap increased the risk by about 7 percent.
Ljudi koji su drijemali ujutro imali su 30 posto veći rizik od onih koji su spavali rano poslijepodne.
People who napped in the morning had 30 percent higher risk than those who slept in the early afternoon.
Autorica studije Chenlu Gao rekla je da istraživanje pokazuje vezu, a ne uzrok.
The study's author Chenlu Gao said the research shows a link, not a cause.
Naučnici kažu da sama dremka ne šteti zdravlju.
The scientists say a nap by itself does not harm health.
Ipak, mnogo dremanja može biti znak bolesti ili problema sa snom koje još niko nije otkrio.
Still, a lot of napping can be a sign of illness or sleep problems that no one has discovered yet.

title: Astronomi otkrili neobičan sistem od tri zvijezde
Astronomers discover an unusual system of three stars
body: Astronomi s Univerziteta u Montrealu otkrili su sistem od tri zvijezde, koji je od Zemlje udaljen 28 svjetlosnih godina.
Astronomers from the University of Montreal have discovered a system of three stars which is 28 light years away from Earth.
Sistem se zove Welopo'ai, a čine ga jedan crveni patuljak i dva bijela patuljka.
The system is called Welopo'ai, and it is made up of one red dwarf and two white dwarfs.
Bijeli patuljak je ostatak zvijezde koja je umrla.
A white dwarf is the remains of a star that has died.
Naučnici su tražili planete oko crvenog patuljka teleskopom na Havajima.
The scientists were looking for planets around the red dwarf with a telescope in Hawaii.
Primijetili su da se brzina zvijezde mijenja mnogo više nego što su očekivali.
They noticed that the star's speed was changing much more than they had expected.
Tako su otkrili nevidljivog pratioca, koji ima 62 posto mase Sunca.
That is how they discovered an invisible companion, which has 62 percent of the Sun's mass.
Crveni patuljak obiđe oko njega za otprilike 10 godina.
The red dwarf goes around it in roughly 10 years.
Taj bijeli patuljak je nekada bio velika zvijezda, koja bi obično progutala manju zvijezdu pored sebe.
That white dwarf was once a big star, which would usually swallow the smaller star next to it.
Zato je jedan od autora rekao da ovaj sistem ne bi trebao postojati.
That is why one of the authors said that this system should not exist.
Naučnici još ne znaju kako je nastao, pa će ga dalje proučavati.
The scientists do not yet know how it formed, so they will study it further.

title: Istraživanje: u zemljama s više mačaka ljudi su sretniji
Study: people are happier in countries with more cats
body: Naučnici su u 93 države uporedili koliko su ljudi sretni i koliko ima mačaka.
Scientists compared in 93 countries how happy people are and how many cats there are.
Istraživanje je vodio Dario Maestripieri s Univerziteta u Chicagu.
The study was led by Dario Maestripieri of the University of Chicago.
Rezultati su objavljeni u naučnom časopisu PLOS ONE.
The results were published in the scientific journal PLOS ONE.
Podaci o sreći dolaze iz anketa agencije Gallup od 2022. do 2024. godine.
The data on happiness come from Gallup surveys from 2022 to 2024.
U zemljama s više mačaka ljudi su u prosjeku bili zadovoljniji životom.
In countries with more cats people were on average more satisfied with life.
Ipak, bogatstvo zemlje i prihodi bili su još jače povezani sa srećom.
However, the wealth of a country and incomes were even more strongly linked to happiness.
Naučnici su gledali i parazit toksoplazmu, koji živi u crijevima mačaka.
The scientists also looked at the parasite toxoplasma, which lives in the intestines of cats.
Gdje je više ljudi nedavno zaraženo tim parazitom, ljudi su bili manje sretni.
Where more people had recently been infected with that parasite, people were less happy.
U bogatijim zemljama mačke češće žive u kući i redovno se vakcinišu.
In richer countries cats more often live indoors and are regularly vaccinated.
Autori upozoravaju da podaci ne razlikuju kućne mačke od onih koje žive na ulici.
The authors warn that the data do not distinguish pet cats from those that live on the street.
Rekli su da ne mogu tvrditi da mačke ljude čine sretnijim, ali da tu vezu treba dalje istraživati.
They said they cannot claim that cats make people happier, but that the link should be researched further.

title: Elektroprivreda BiH traži prevoz uglja vozom za 2027. godinu
Elektroprivreda BiH seeks rail transport of coal for 2027
body: Elektroprivreda BiH traži firmu koja će 2027. godine vozom prevoziti ugalj.
Elektroprivreda BiH is looking for a company that will transport coal by train in 2027.
Ugalj treba stizati u termoelektrane u Tuzli i Kaknju, koje od njega proizvode struju.
The coal is to arrive at the thermal power plants in Tuzla and Kakanj, which produce electricity from it.
Obavještenje je objavljeno danas, a vrijednost posla je 28,6 miliona KM s PDV-om.
The notice was published today, and the value of the job is 28.6 million KM including VAT.
Prevoz će trajati od 1. januara do 31. decembra 2027. godine.
The transport will last from 1 January to 31 December 2027.
Koliko uglja treba prevesti, u obavještenju nije navedeno.
How much coal needs to be transported is not stated in the notice.
Posao nije otvoren za javni poziv, a pobijedit će najjeftinija ponuda.
The job is not open to a public call, and the cheapest bid will win.
Firme se mogu prijaviti do 4. decembra u 10 sati.
Companies can apply until 4 December at 10 o'clock.
Ovaj posao je za 2026. godinu dobila firma JP Željeznice FBiH, koja je bila jedini ponuđač.
This job for 2026 was won by the company JP Željeznice FBiH, which was the only bidder.
Taj ugovor je bio vrijedan 28,8 miliona KM s PDV-om.
That contract was worth 28.8 million KM including VAT.
Prije nekoliko dana Elektroprivreda je pokrenula i nabavku samog uglja za 2027. godinu.
A few days ago Elektroprivreda also launched the purchase of the coal itself for 2027.
Vrijednost te nabavke je 121,7 miliona KM s PDV-om.
The value of that purchase is 121.7 million KM including VAT.

title: Novi stanovi u Republici Srpskoj poskupili 8,8 posto
New apartments in Republika Srpska 8.8 percent more expensive
body: Cijene novih stanova u Republici Srpskoj nastavljaju rasti.
Prices of new apartments in Republika Srpska continue to rise.
Od jula do septembra kvadratni metar koštao je u prosjeku 3.103 KM.
From July to September a square metre cost 3,103 KM on average.
To je 8,8 posto više nego u istom periodu prošle godine, javio je Republički zavod za statistiku.
That is 8.8 percent more than in the same period last year, the Republic Statistics Office reported.
U ta tri mjeseca prodan je 921 novi stan, a ukupna vrijednost bila je oko 151,7 miliona KM.
In those three months 921 new apartments were sold, and the total value was about 151.7 million KM.
Najviše stanova prodano je u Banjoj Luci, njih 367, po prosječnoj cijeni od 3.887 KM.
The most apartments were sold in Banja Luka, 367 of them, at an average price of 3,887 KM.
U centru grada kvadrat može koštati od 6.000 do 8.000 KM.
In the city centre a square metre can cost from 6,000 to 8,000 KM.
Najskuplji su stanovi u Trebinju, gdje je prosjek 4.389 KM po kvadratu.
The most expensive apartments are in Trebinje, where the average is 4,389 KM per square metre.
Bijeljina je druga po prodaji, sa 213 stanova.
Bijeljina is second in sales, with 213 apartments.
Od cijene jednog kvadrata, 1.802 KM otpada na gradnju i zaradu izvođača.
Of the price of one square metre, 1,802 KM goes to construction and the builder's profit.
Agent za nekretnine Mirko Stanković rekao je za RTRS da stan od 45 kvadrata u Trebinju košta od 190.000 do 200.000 KM.
Real estate agent Mirko Stanković told RTRS that a 45-square-metre apartment in Trebinje costs from 190,000 to 200,000 KM.
Cijena zavisi od lokacije, kvaliteta gradnje i investitora.
The price depends on the location, the quality of construction and the developer.

title: Nova Skupština Hercegovačko-neretvanskog kantona održala prvu sjednicu
New Assembly of Herzegovina-Neretva Canton holds its first session
body: Skupština Hercegovačko-neretvanskog kantona održala je danas u Mostaru prvu sjednicu novog saziva.
The Assembly of Herzegovina-Neretva Canton held the first session of its new term today in Mostar.
Na sjednici je skupština i zvanično počela s radom.
At the session the assembly also officially started its work.
U rukovodstvo su izabrani Džafer Alić iz SDA, Damir Džeba iz HDZ-a BiH i Vesna Saradžić iz SDP-a.
Džafer Alić of the SDA, Damir Džeba of HDZ BiH and Vesna Saradžić of the SDP were elected to the leadership.
Skupština ima 30 zastupnika iz 7 stranaka i koalicija.
The assembly has 30 members from 7 parties and coalitions.
Najviše mjesta, njih 13, osvojila je koalicija oko HDZ-a BiH.
The most seats, 13 of them, were won by the coalition around HDZ BiH.
SDA ima 8 zastupnika, a SDP 3.
The SDA has 8 members, and the SDP 3.
HDZ 1990 – HSS i HRS imaju po 2 zastupnika, dok NES i DF/GS imaju po jednog.
HDZ 1990 – HSS and HRS have 2 members each, while NES and DF/GS have one each.
Ovi rezultati su potvrđeni od Centralne izborne komisije BiH.
These results were confirmed by the Central Election Commission of BiH.
Izabrani su i predsjednici klubova hrvatskog, bošnjačkog i srpskog naroda.
The presidents of the Croat, Bosniak and Serb caucuses were also elected.
Klubovi do utorka u 12 sati trebaju predložiti kandidate za Dom naroda Parlamenta FBiH.
By Tuesday at 12 o'clock the caucuses must nominate candidates for the House of Peoples of the FBiH Parliament.
Iz ovog kantona u Dom naroda bira se 9 delegata.
From this canton 9 delegates are elected to the House of Peoples.

title: Ministri iz SNSD-a blokirat će sutrašnju sjednicu Vijeća ministara
SNSD ministers will block tomorrow's session of the Council of Ministers
body: Ministri iz Republike Srpske najavili su da će blokirati sutrašnju sjednicu Vijeća ministara BiH.
Ministers from Republika Srpska have announced that they will block tomorrow's session of the BiH Council of Ministers.
Tako žele pokazati da se ne slažu s odlukama Ustavnog suda BiH.
In this way they want to show that they disagree with decisions of the Constitutional Court of BiH.
To je za agenciju Srna rekao Staša Košarac, zamjenik predsjedavajućeg Vijeća ministara.
This was said to the Srna agency by Staša Košarac, deputy chairman of the Council of Ministers.
Ministri će vjerovatno doći na sjednicu, ali neće glasati ni o jednoj tački dnevnog reda.
The ministers will probably come to the session, but they will not vote on any item on the agenda.
Bez njihovih glasova Vijeće ministara ne može donositi odluke.
Without their votes the Council of Ministers cannot make decisions.
Košarac traži da se rad zaustavi dok Ustavni sud ne povuče svoje posljednje odluke.
Košarac is asking for work to stop until the Constitutional Court withdraws its latest decisions.
Sud je poništio izjavu Željke Cvijanović o vitalnom interesu Republike Srpske.
The court annulled a statement by Željka Cvijanović on the vital interest of Republika Srpska.
Osim toga, odlučio je da je neustavna kazna za isticanje simbola Armije RBiH.
Besides that, it ruled that a penalty for displaying symbols of the Army of RBiH is unconstitutional.
Košarac je rekao da je sud napravio vanrednu situaciju u državi.
Košarac said that the court had created a state of emergency in the country.
Prema njegovim riječima, u takvoj situaciji ne mogu se održavati redovne sjednice.
According to him, regular sessions cannot be held in such a situation.
Dodao je da se ministri iz RS-a ne mogu ponašati kao da se ništa nije dogodilo.
He added that the ministers from RS cannot act as if nothing had happened.

title: Konaković oštro kritikovao izbor Igora Dodika za mandatara
Konaković sharply criticises the choice of Igor Dodik as prime minister-designate
body: Ministar vanjskih poslova BiH Elmedin Konaković kritikovao je Milorada Dodika na Facebooku.
BiH Foreign Minister Elmedin Konaković criticised Milorad Dodik on Facebook.
Povod je izbor Igora Dodika za mandatara za novu vladu Republike Srpske.
The reason is the choice of Igor Dodik as prime minister-designate for the new government of Republika Srpska.
Igor je sin Milorada Dodika, predsjednika SNSD-a, a izabran je u nedjelju.
Igor is the son of Milorad Dodik, president of the SNSD, and he was chosen on Sunday.
Konaković, koji je i predsjednik stranke Narod i pravda, napisao je da je Dodik podigao bezobrazluk na viši nivo.
Konaković, who is also president of the Narod i pravda party, wrote that Dodik had raised impudence to a higher level.
Rekao je da mu je Dodik jednom priznao da je bezobrazluk uspio "legalizovati" u politici.
He said that Dodik had once admitted to him that he had managed to "legalise" impudence in politics.
Prema Konakoviću, mnoge porodice u RS-u svoju djecu vide samo preko video poziva jer su otišla iz zemlje.
According to Konaković, many families in RS see their children only via video calls because they have left the country.
Porodica Dodik će, kako tvrdi, imati nove poslovne prilike.
The Dodik family, as he claims, will have new business opportunities.
Konaković tvrdi i da će troškove porodice plaćati budžet Republike Srpske.
Konaković also claims that the family's costs will be paid by the budget of Republika Srpska.
On kaže da je taj budžet već prazan.
He says that this budget is already empty.
Objavu je završio poslovicom: "Najlakše je šišati one koji misle da ih češljaš."
He ended the post with a proverb: "It is easiest to cut the hair of those who think you are combing them."

title: Vučić tvrdi da je u nedjelju dobio prijetnje smrću
Vučić claims he received death threats on Sunday
body: Aleksandar Vučić tvrdi da je u nedjelju dobio najteže prijetnje smrću.
Aleksandar Vučić claims that on Sunday he received the most serious death threats.
To je rekao na televiziji Pink, gdje je govorio o političkoj krizi u Srbiji.
He said this on Pink television, where he spoke about the political crisis in Serbia.
Vučić je sada šef poslaničke grupe SNS-a u parlamentu.
Vučić is now head of the SNS parliamentary group.
Prema njegovim riječima, prijetnje su došle od takozvanog "vračarskog" klana.
According to him, the threats came from the so-called "Vračar" clan.
Klan je kriminalna grupa, a Vračar je dio Beograda.
A clan is a criminal group, and Vračar is a part of Belgrade.
Rekao je da je dobio jasnu poruku da će biti ubijen.
He said that he had received a clear message that he would be killed.
Nije rekao ko mu je prijetio niti da li je poruka stigla telefonom.
He did not say who had threatened him or whether the message came by phone.
Vučić kaže da prijetnje nema kome prijaviti jer, kako tvrdi, policija ne postoji.
Vučić says he has no one to report the threats to because, as he claims, the police do not exist.
Dodao je da nije vidio da je iko uhapšen zbog paljenja teretana i druge imovine.
He added that he had not seen anyone arrested for burning gyms and other property.
Kao primjer je naveo hapšenje gradonačelnika Smedereva zbog nelegalne deponije otpada.
As an example he mentioned the arrest of the mayor of Smederevo over an illegal waste dump.

title: Tuzla za praznike sprema 24 večeri koncerata
Tuzla prepares 24 evenings of concerts for the holidays
body: Tuzla priprema veliki program za novogodišnje praznike pod nazivom "Zima u Tuzli".
Tuzla is preparing a big programme for the New Year holidays called "Winter in Tuzla".
Manifestacija će trajati od 18. decembra do 10. januara na Trgu slobode.
The event will last from 18 December to 10 January on Freedom Square.
Organizuju je Grad Tuzla i Turistička organizacija Grada Tuzle.
It is organised by the City of Tuzla and the Tourist Organisation of the City of Tuzla.
Na programu je 37 izvođača, a koncert će biti svake od 24 večeri.
There are 37 performers on the programme, and there will be a concert on each of the 24 evenings.
Čak 20 muzičara je iz Tuzle, 9 iz drugih gradova BiH, a 6 iz Hrvatske.
As many as 20 musicians are from Tuzla, 9 from other cities in BiH, and 6 from Croatia.
Nastupit će, između ostalih, Šejla Zonić, TBF, Ilma Karahmet i Zvonko Bogdan.
Among others, Šejla Zonić, TBF, Ilma Karahmet and Zvonko Bogdan will perform.
Na trgu će biti 23 kućice, što je najviše do sada.
There will be 23 stalls on the square, the most so far.
U 18 kućica nudit će se hrana i piće, a u 5 proizvodi malih zanatlija.
Food and drink will be offered in 18 stalls, and products of small craftspeople in 5.
Za djecu će svakog vikenda biti zabava na trgu i u Gradskom parku.
For children there will be entertainment every weekend on the square and in the City Park.
Novu 2027. godinu građani će dočekati uz koncert Severine.
Citizens will welcome the new year 2027 with a concert by Severina.
Organizatori kažu da manifestacija pomaže i lokalnim kafićima, restoranima, hotelima i taksistima.
The organisers say the event also helps local cafés, restaurants, hotels and taxi drivers.

title: Šaka kikirikija dnevno mogla bi pomoći pamćenju
A handful of peanuts a day could help memory
body: Naučnici s Univerziteta u Maastrichtu u Holandiji istraživali su kako kikiriki utječe na mozak.
Scientists from Maastricht University in the Netherlands studied how peanuts affect the brain.
U istraživanju je učestvovala 31 zdrava starija osoba.
31 healthy older people took part in the study.
Oni su 16 sedmica svaki dan jeli 60 grama nesoljenog pečenog kikirikija s opnom.
For 16 weeks they ate 60 grams of unsalted roasted peanuts with skins every day.
Kratkoročno pamćenje riječi poboljšalo se za 5,8 posto.
Short-term memory for words improved by 5.8 percent.
Protok krvi u mozgu povećao se za 3,6 posto.
Blood flow in the brain increased by 3.6 percent.
Glavni autor Peter Joris rekao je da to pokazuje da krvni sudovi u mozgu bolje rade.
Lead author Peter Joris said this shows that the blood vessels in the brain work better.
Opna kikirikija sadrži polifenole, tvari koje štite ćelije.
The peanut skin contains polyphenols, substances that protect cells.
Dvije porcije imaju oko 320 kalorija, pa nutricionisti savjetuju da kikiriki zamijeni manje zdrave grickalice.
Two servings have about 320 calories, so nutritionists advise that peanuts should replace less healthy snacks.
Istraživanje je dijelom platila organizacija iz industrije kikirikija.
The study was partly paid for by an organisation from the peanut industry.
Stručnjak Thomas Holland upozorio je da zdravlje mozga ne zavisi od jedne namirnice.
Expert Thomas Holland warned that brain health does not depend on one food.
Rekao je da su važni i losos, jaja, orasi, borovnice, kretanje i dobar san.
He said that salmon, eggs, walnuts, blueberries, exercise and good sleep are also important.

title: Publika izviždala Miss Izraela na izboru za Miss Universe
Audience boos Miss Israel at the Miss Universe pageant
body: Predstavnicu Izraela Danielle Yablonku dio publike izviždao je na izboru za Miss Universe.
Part of the audience booed Israel's representative Danielle Yablonka at the Miss Universe pageant.
To se dogodilo u subotu navečer u Portoriku, gdje se ove godine održava takmičenje.
It happened on Saturday evening in Puerto Rico, where the competition is being held this year.
Kandidatkinje su tada predstavljale nacionalne kostime.
The contestants were presenting national costumes at the time.
Yablonka ima 25 godina, rođena je u Miamiju i radi kao model i influenserica.
Yablonka is 25 years old, was born in Miami and works as a model and influencer.
Na sebi je imala krunu i ogrtač sa slikom Starog grada Jerusalema.
She wore a crown and a cape with a picture of the Old City of Jerusalem.
S unutrašnje strane ogrtača bile su narandže, masline i riječ mir na tri jezika.
On the inside of the cape there were oranges, olive trees and the word peace in three languages.
Kostim je napravio dizajner Jacob Meir.
The costume was made by designer Jacob Meir.
Nastup je izazvao jake reakcije na društvenim mrežama.
The appearance caused strong reactions on social networks.
Mnogi su u komentarima tražili slobodu za Palestinu.
Many people in the comments called for freedom for Palestine.
Organizacija Miss Izraela izabrala je Yablonku jer je nacionalno takmičenje otkazano zbog rata.
The Miss Israel organisation chose Yablonka because the national competition was cancelled due to the war.
Finale izbora zakazano je za utorak.
The final of the pageant is scheduled for Tuesday.

title: Mokre ceste i mnogo vode na kolovozima širom BiH
Wet roads and lots of water on roadways across BiH
body: Vozači u većem dijelu BiH jutros voze po mokrim cestama, a na mnogim mjestima stoji voda.
Drivers in most of BiH are driving on wet roads this morning, and in many places water is standing.
Informativni centar BIHAMK-a savjetuje vozače da voze oprezno i sporije.
The BIHAMK information centre advises drivers to drive carefully and more slowly.
Upozorava i na odrone na usjecima, a u dolinama i pored rijeka može biti magle.
It also warns of rockfalls on road cuttings, and there may be fog in valleys and next to rivers.
Na nekoliko planinskih prijevoja pao je snijeg, ali ne smeta saobraćaju.
Snow has fallen on several mountain passes, but it does not disrupt traffic.
Snijeg ima na Laništu, Oštrelju, Rogoju i Makljenu, kao i na cesti Posušje – Blidinje.
There is snow on Lanište, Oštrelj, Rogoj and Makljen, as well as on the Posušje – Blidinje road.
Na autoputu kod Zenice saobraćaj je usporen na ulazu u tunel Klopče zbog radova.
On the motorway near Zenica traffic is slowed at the entrance to the Klopče tunnel because of works.
Zbog radova se na mnogim cestama vozi samo jednom trakom.
Because of works, on many roads traffic uses only one lane.
Na Romaniji se gradi dodatna traka za spora vozila, pa je saobraćaj usporen.
On Romanija an extra lane for slow vehicles is being built, so traffic is slowed.
Na dionici Srbljani – Bosanska Krupa zabranjen je prolaz vozilima težim od 20 tona.
On the Srbljani – Bosanska Krupa section vehicles heavier than 20 tonnes are banned.
Na graničnim prijelazima putnička vozila ne čekaju duže od 30 minuta.
At border crossings passenger vehicles do not wait longer than 30 minutes.

title: Nakon jakog nevremena mnoge ulice u Mostaru pod vodom
After a heavy storm many streets in Mostar are under water
body: Jako nevrijeme pogodilo je Mostar u nedjelju navečer, a mnoge ulice brzo su bile pod vodom.
A heavy storm hit Mostar on Sunday evening, and many streets were quickly under water.
Kiša je padala cijeli dan, a malo prije 22:00 počela je i grmljavina.
Rain fell all day, and shortly before 22:00 thunder also began.
Na cestama je stajala voda, pa se saobraćaj na više mjesta kretao sporo.
Water stood on the roads, so traffic moved slowly in several places.
Samo između 21:00 i 22:00 palo je 29,6 litara kiše po metru kvadratnom.
Between 21:00 and 22:00 alone, 29.6 litres of rain per square metre fell.
To je skoro pola od 63 litra koliko je palo u posljednja 24 sata.
That is almost half of the 63 litres that fell in the last 24 hours.
Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod ranije je izdao upozorenje za regiju Mostara.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute had earlier issued a warning for the Mostar region.
Prognoza je bila od 30 do 60 litara, a lokalno i do 70 litara po metru kvadratnom.
The forecast was 30 to 60 litres, and locally up to 70 litres per square metre.
Poplavljene ulice ponovo su pokazale da Mostar ima problem s odvodom vode nakon jake kiše.
The flooded streets showed again that Mostar has a problem with drainage after heavy rain.
Još nije poznato da li su vatrogasci morali intervenisati i da li ima materijalne štete.
It is not yet known whether firefighters had to intervene and whether there is material damage.
Za danas se na jugu BiH očekuje jak sjeverozapadni vjetar s udarima preko 70 kilometara na sat.
Today a strong north-west wind with gusts over 70 kilometres per hour is expected in the south of BiH.
Kiša bi trebala prestati poslijepodne.
The rain should stop in the afternoon.

title: CNN: Najviše napada na brodove u Hormuškom moreuzu od početka rata
CNN: Most attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz since the start of the war
body: Broj napada na brodove u Hormuškom moreuzu najveći je od početka rata između SAD-a i Irana.
The number of attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz is the highest since the start of the war between the US and Iran.
To pokazuje analiza američke televizije CNN, koja je koristila britanske podatke.
This is shown by an analysis by the American television network CNN, which used British data.
Moreuz je uski morski prolaz kroz koji je prije rata prolazila petina svjetske nafte.
The strait is a narrow sea passage through which a fifth of the world's oil passed before the war.
U oktobru je zabilježeno više od 30 napada, prvi put od početka rata krajem februara.
In October more than 30 attacks were recorded, for the first time since the start of the war at the end of February.
Do nedjelje je u novembru bilo najmanje 22 napada.
By Sunday there had been at least 22 attacks in November.
Prije oktobra prosjek je bio oko 10 napada mjesečno.
Before October the average was about 10 attacks per month.
Pravi broj je vjerovatno veći, jer mnogi brodovi ne prijavljuju napade.
The real number is probably higher, because many ships do not report attacks.
Iranska vojska kaže da se incidenti s brodovima dešavaju skoro svaki dan, uglavnom zbog morskih mina.
The Iranian army says that incidents with ships happen almost every day, mostly because of sea mines.
Cijene nafte padaju, pa Iran teže zarađuje od prodaje.
Oil prices are falling, so Iran finds it harder to earn from sales.
Stručnjaci za CNN kažu da Iran gubi utjecaj na moreuz.
Experts told CNN that Iran is losing influence over the strait.
Ipak, smatraju da bi Iran mogao pojačati napade kako bi dobio ustupke od Washingtona.
However, they believe Iran could step up attacks in order to get concessions from Washington.

title: Trump za pad cijena nafte krivi Iran i demokrate
Trump blames Iran and the Democrats for the fall in oil prices
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump u nedjelju je napisao da su cijene nafte naglo pale nakon izbora u SAD-u.
US President Donald Trump wrote on Sunday that oil prices fell sharply after the elections in the US.
Na tim izborima republikanci su teško izgubili, a Trump je situaciju nazvao ogromnom prevarom.
The Republicans lost heavily in those elections, and Trump called the situation a huge fraud.
Svoje mišljenje objavio je u dvije poruke na mreži Truth Social.
He published his opinion in two posts on the Truth Social network.
U drugoj poruci optužio je demokrate i Iran da su namjerno držali visoke cijene nafte do izbora.
In the second post he accused the Democrats and Iran of deliberately keeping oil prices high until the elections.
Prema njegovim riječima, cijene od tada padaju rekordnom brzinom.
According to him, prices have been falling at record speed since then.
Trump tvrdi da je prije izbora 3. novembra predvidio pad tržišta ako pobijede demokrate.
Trump claims that before the 3 November elections he predicted a market fall if the Democrats won.
Rekao je i da će Iran tada postati agresivniji, a sada kaže da se to dogodilo.
He also said that Iran would then become more aggressive, and now he says that has happened.
Trump je napisao da je šteta što birači to nisu razumjeli prije nego što su glasali.
Trump wrote that it is a pity voters did not understand this before they voted.
Cijeli izborni proces nazvao je vrlo čudnim.
He called the whole election process very strange.
Cijene nafte i goriva jako su porasle nakon što su SAD 28. februara počele rat protiv Irana.
Oil and fuel prices rose sharply after the US started a war against Iran on 28 February.
Tokom ljeta Trump je kritikovao naftne kompanije jer nisu dovoljno spustile cijene na pumpama.
During the summer Trump criticised oil companies because they did not lower prices at the pumps enough.
Zato je tražio da Ministarstvo pravde SAD-a pokrene istragu.
That is why he asked the US Department of Justice to start an investigation.

title: Južnokorejski ministar podnio ostavku zbog varanja na ispitima
South Korean minister resigns over cheating in exams
body: Ministar obrazovanja Južne Koreje Choi Kyo-jin podnio je ostavku u nedjelju.
South Korea's education minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned on Sunday.
Ministar ima 72 godine i preuzeo je odgovornost za probleme na prijemnom ispitu za fakultete.
The minister is 72 years old and took responsibility for the problems at the university entrance exam.
Predsjednik Lee Jae Myung prihvatio je ostavku za manje od sat vremena.
President Lee Jae Myung accepted the resignation in less than an hour.
Nacionalni ispit Suneung traje 8 sati i održan je prošle sedmice.
The national Suneung exam lasts 8 hours and was held last week.
Vlasti su u zadnji čas uvele mjere protiv varanja pomoću umjetne inteligencije, odnosno AI.
At the last minute the authorities introduced measures against cheating with artificial intelligence, or AI.
Ograničile su Wi-Fi, a provjeravale su i naočale i dugmad na odjeći zbog skrivenih uređaja.
They restricted Wi-Fi, and they also checked glasses and buttons on clothes for hidden devices.
Na mobitele u cijeloj zemlji slale su poruke kako bi pronašle skrivene telefone.
They sent messages to mobile phones across the whole country in order to find hidden phones.
Mjere su uvedene nakon što je najbolji kandidat na jednom državnom ispitu priznao da je varao.
The measures were introduced after the top candidate in one state exam admitted that he had cheated.
Koristio je malu kameru, mobitel i alate umjetne inteligencije.
He used a small camera, a mobile phone and artificial intelligence tools.
Ranije ovog mjeseca Choi je u parlamentu rekao da vlasti ne mogu otkriti svako takvo varanje.
Earlier this month Choi said in parliament that the authorities cannot detect every such case of cheating.
Predsjednik je sada naredio da se provjeri cijela organizacija državnih ispita.
The president has now ordered a check of the whole organisation of state exams.

title: Danas susnježica i snijeg u Bosni, stiže zahlađenje
Sleet and snow in Bosnia today, colder weather is coming
body: U ponedjeljak prijepodne u BiH će biti oblačno, a u Bosni se očekuju susnježica i snijeg.
On Monday morning it will be cloudy in BiH, and sleet and snow are expected in Bosnia.
U Hercegovini i nižim dijelovima Bosne padat će kiša, a na planinama snijeg.
In Herzegovina and the lower parts of Bosnia it will rain, and on the mountains it will snow.
Poslijepodne bi padavine trebale prestati, a nebo će se djelimično razvedriti.
In the afternoon the precipitation should stop, and the sky will partly clear.
Jugo se ujutro mijenja u umjeren i jak sjeverni i sjeverozapadni vjetar.
In the morning the south wind changes into a moderate and strong north and north-west wind.
Udari vjetra bit će od 30 do 60 kilometara na sat, a na jugu i preko 70.
Wind gusts will be from 30 to 60 kilometres per hour, and in the south over 70.
Temperatura će uglavnom biti od 2 do 8 stepeni, a na jugu do 14.
The temperature will mostly be from 2 to 8 degrees, and in the south up to 14.
U Sarajevu se prijepodne očekuje kiša, a temperatura od 3 do 5 stepeni.
In Sarajevo rain is expected in the morning, and a temperature of 3 to 5 degrees.
Noć će biti vedra i hladnija, sa slabim mrazom.
The night will be clear and colder, with slight frost.
Najniža temperatura bit će od -2 do 2 stepena, a u višim predjelima oko -5.
The lowest temperature will be from -2 to 2 degrees, and in higher areas around -5.
U utorak se očekuje uglavnom sunčano vrijeme, a najtoplije će biti u Mostaru i Trebinju.
On Tuesday mostly sunny weather is expected, and it will be warmest in Mostar and Trebinje.

title: Amira Medunjanin održala koncert sevdaha u Sarajevu
Amira Medunjanin held a sevdah concert in Sarajevo
body: Pjevačica Amira Medunjanin u nedjelju navečer održala je koncert u Bosanskom kulturnom centru u Sarajevu.
Singer Amira Medunjanin held a concert at the Bosnian Cultural Centre in Sarajevo on Sunday evening.
Nastupila je s gudačima Sarajevske filharmonije.
She performed with the strings of the Sarajevo Philharmonic.
Dvorana je bila puna, a publika ju je dočekala velikim aplauzom.
The hall was full, and the audience welcomed her with loud applause.
Na sceni je bilo ukupno 14 muzičara, zajedno s Amirom.
There were 14 musicians on stage in total, including Amira.
Sevdalinke su izvedene u novim aranžmanima, pa su imale drugačiji zvuk.
The sevdalinkas were performed in new arrangements, so they had a different sound.
Ipak, pjesme su zadržale svoju staru emociju i toplinu.
Still, the songs kept their old emotion and warmth.
Publika je čula pjesme Moj dilbere, U Stambolu na Bosforu i Snijeg pade na behar na voće.
The audience heard the songs Moj dilbere, U Stambolu na Bosforu and Snijeg pade na behar na voće.
Pjesme govore o ljubavi, čežnji, rastanku i životu.
The songs are about love, longing, parting and life.
Prije koncerta u Sarajevu Amira je nastupila u zagrebačkoj dvorani Vatroslav Lisinski.
Before the concert in Sarajevo, Amira performed in Zagreb's Vatroslav Lisinski hall.
Tamo je pjevala s ansamblom Zagrebački solisti.
There she sang with the ensemble Zagreb Soloists.
U Sarajevu je sada prvi put nastupila s gudačima Sarajevske filharmonije.
In Sarajevo she has now performed for the first time with the strings of the Sarajevo Philharmonic.

title: Psi razlikuju strah i ljutnju na ljudskom licu
Dogs can tell fear and anger apart on a human face
body: Psi mogu razlikovati nekoliko negativnih izraza na ljudskom licu, pokazalo je novo istraživanje.
Dogs can distinguish several negative expressions on the human face, a new study has shown.
Ranije se znalo da psi razlikuju sretna lica od tužnih ili ljutih.
It was previously known that dogs distinguish happy faces from sad or angry ones.
Autori kažu da je ovo prvi direktan dokaz da psi razlikuju i negativne emocije međusobno.
The authors say this is the first direct evidence that dogs also distinguish negative emotions from each other.
Naučnici su snimali mozak pasa magnetnom rezonancom dok su gledali fotografije nepoznatih ljudi.
Scientists recorded the dogs' brains with magnetic resonance imaging while they looked at photos of unknown people.
U prvom dijelu 8 pasa gledalo je sretna i neutralna lica.
In the first part, 8 dogs looked at happy and neutral faces.
U drugom dijelu 12 pasa gledalo je lica sa srećom, ljutnjom, strahom i tugom.
In the second part, 12 dogs looked at faces with happiness, anger, fear and sadness.
Mozak je reagovao drugačije na strah nego na ljutnju i tugu, ali ljutnju i tugu nije jasno razlikovao.
The brain reacted differently to fear than to anger and sadness, but it did not clearly distinguish anger and sadness.
Istraživači upozoravaju da to ne znači da psi razumiju emocije kao ljudi.
The researchers warn that this does not mean that dogs understand emotions the way people do.
U istraživanju je bilo malo pasa, a većina su bili border koliji naučeni da mirno leže.
There were few dogs in the study, and most were border collies trained to lie still.
Naučnici bi u budućnosti željeli ispitati kako psi koriste i glas i govor tijela.
In the future scientists would like to examine how dogs also use voice and body language.

title: Kako spavati bez mobitela, a ostati dostupan za hitne pozive
How to sleep without a phone and stay reachable for urgent calls
body: Stručnjaci za san savjetuju da mobitel ne držimo u spavaćoj sobi.
Sleep experts advise that we do not keep the phone in the bedroom.
Mnogi ljudi se ipak boje da neće čuti važan poziv tokom noći.
Many people are still afraid that they will not hear an important call during the night.
Zato stručnjaci predlažu da se navika mijenja polako, korak po korak.
That is why experts suggest changing the habit slowly, step by step.
Prema istraživanju iz septembra, 62 posto Amerikanaca mlađih od 30 godina kaže da zbog mobitela manje spava.
According to a survey from September, 62 percent of Americans younger than 30 say that they sleep less because of the phone.
Profesor Jamie Zeitzer sa Univerziteta Stanford kaže da nas obavijesti mogu probuditi noću.
Professor Jamie Zeitzer from Stanford University says that notifications can wake us up at night.
Plavo svjetlo ekrana također remeti san, čak i kada je uključen noćni način rada.
The blue light of the screen also disturbs sleep, even when night mode is switched on.
U jednom istraživanju ljudi su sedmicu dana spavali bez mobitela u sobi, a tri od četiri su brže zaspala.
In one study people slept for a week without a phone in the room, and three out of four fell asleep faster.
Stručnjaci savjetuju da mobitel prvo stavimo dalje od kreveta, a zatim izvan sobe.
Experts advise that we first put the phone further from the bed, and then outside the room.
Za buđenje je dobro kupiti običan budilnik.
For waking up it is good to buy an ordinary alarm clock.
Na većini telefona može se podesiti da zvoni ako ista osoba zove nekoliko puta, čak i kada je uključen način Ne uznemiravaj.
On most phones you can set it to ring if the same person calls several times, even when Do Not Disturb mode is on.

title: Iz kuće biznismena u Japanu ukradeno 20 kilograma zlata
20 kilograms of gold stolen from a businessman's house in Japan
body: Nepoznati lopovi su u subotu provalili u kuću jednog biznismena u japanskom gradu Nishinomiya.
Unknown thieves broke into the house of a businessman in the Japanese city of Nishinomiya on Saturday.
Ukrali su oko 20 kilograma zlata i 25 miliona jena u gotovini, javila je televizija NHK.
They stole about 20 kilograms of gold and 25 million yen in cash, the television station NHK reported.
Vlasnik kuće ima 44 godine i nije bio kod kuće.
The owner of the house is 44 years old and was not at home.
Alarm se uključio oko 02:30 po lokalnom vremenu.
The alarm went off at about 02:30 local time.
Kada je policija stigla, vrata su bila razbijena.
When the police arrived, the door was broken.
Vlasnik je kasnije vidio da nema novca i dvadesetak zlatnih poluga od po jedan kilogram.
The owner later saw that the money and about twenty gold bars of one kilogram each were missing.
Zlato vrijedi oko 400 miliona jena, odnosno oko 4,5 miliona KM.
The gold is worth about 400 million yen, that is about 4.5 million KM.
Ukupno su lopovi uzeli oko 4,8 miliona KM.
In total the thieves took about 4.8 million KM.
Policija slučaj vodi kao krađu i traga za počiniocima.
The police are treating the case as a theft and are searching for the perpetrators.
Japanski mediji nisu objavili ime vlasnika ni njegove firme.
The Japanese media have not published the name of the owner or of his company.
Za sada nema ni osumnjičenih.
For now there are no suspects either.

title: Milorad Dodik čestitao sinu: Igor je moj ponos
Milorad Dodik congratulates his son: Igor is my pride
body: Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik u nedjelju je na Instagramu čestitao sinu Igoru.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik congratulated his son Igor on Instagram on Sunday.
Igor Dodik je istog dana predložen za mandatara nove Vlade Republike Srpske.
On the same day Igor Dodik was proposed as prime minister-designate of the new Government of Republika Srpska.
Predložio ga je predsjednik RS-a Savo Minić nakon razgovora s partnerima u koaliciji.
He was proposed by RS President Savo Minić after talks with partners in the coalition.
Milorad Dodik je napisao da je Igor njegov ponos i njegova pobjeda.
Milorad Dodik wrote that Igor is his pride and his victory.
Rekao je i da je on dijete SNSD-a, jer je tako naučen.
He also said that he is a child of the SNSD, because that is how he was raised.
Prema njegovim riječima, sada su potrebni odgovornost, ozbiljan rad i jedinstvo.
In his words, responsibility, serious work and unity are needed now.
Dodik vjeruje u znanje i iskustvo svog sina, ali i u novu energiju mlađe generacije.
Dodik believes in his son's knowledge and experience, but also in the new energy of the younger generation.
Napisao je da nikada nije bio sigurniji i ponosniji nego danas.
He wrote that he had never been more certain and prouder than today.
Igor Dodik je organizacioni sekretar SNSD-a i bio bi najmlađi mandatar u historiji RS-a.
Igor Dodik is the organisational secretary of the SNSD and would be the youngest prime minister-designate in the history of RS.
Na izborima u oktobru prvi put je bio kandidat za Narodnu skupštinu.
In the elections in October he was a candidate for the National Assembly for the first time.
Prema prvim rezultatima, dobio je najviše ličnih glasova, ukupno 18.104.
According to the first results, he won the most personal votes, 18,104 in total.
Prijedlog sada mora potvrditi Narodna skupština RS-a.
The National Assembly of RS must now confirm the proposal.

title: Eisenkot osudio napade doseljenika na palestinska sela
Eisenkot condemns settler attacks on Palestinian villages
body: Izraelski doseljenici su u nedjelju rano ujutro napali nekoliko palestinskih sela na okupiranoj Zapadnoj obali.
Israeli settlers attacked several Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank early on Sunday morning.
Zapalili su automobile i na zidove napisali rasističke poruke, a sela se nalaze blizu Ramallaha.
They set cars on fire and wrote racist messages on the walls, and the villages are near Ramallah.
Niko nije povrijeđen i niko nije preuzeo odgovornost za napade.
Nobody was injured and nobody claimed responsibility for the attacks.
Gadi Eisenkot, lider opozicije, rekao je da je to jevrejski terorizam.
Gadi Eisenkot, the opposition leader, said that it is Jewish terrorism.
Prema njegovim riječima, za haos su krivi ministri Itamar Ben-Gvir i Bezalel Smotrich.
In his words, ministers Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich are to blame for the chaos.
Policija je otvorila istragu, a vojska je u četiri sela poslala vojnike i policajce.
The police opened an investigation, and the army sent soldiers and police officers to four villages.
Ben-Gvir je odgovorio da Eisenkot tako traži podršku arapskih stranaka.
Ben-Gvir replied that Eisenkot is seeking the support of Arab parties in this way.
Izbori su održani 27. oktobra, a premijer Benjamin Netanyahu je izgubio većinu u parlamentu.
The elections were held on 27 October, and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu lost his majority in parliament.
Predsjednik Isaac Herzog dao je Eisenkotu mandat da formira novu vladu.
President Isaac Herzog gave Eisenkot the mandate to form a new government.
Za većinu u parlamentu od 120 mjesta vjerovatno bi mu trebale arapske stranke.
For a majority in the 120-seat parliament he would probably need Arab parties.
Ako vlada ne bude formirana, nove izbore očekuju sljedeće godine.
If the government is not formed, new elections are expected next year.

title: Čemu služe zelena, plava i crvena tipka u tramvaju
What the green, blue and red buttons in the tram are for
body: Novi tramvaji u Sarajevu imaju tri tipke u različitim bojama.
The new trams in Sarajevo have three buttons in different colours.
Mnogi putnici ih ne koriste, čak ni oni kojima su namijenjene.
Many passengers do not use them, not even those they are meant for.
Na svakoj tipki je slika koja pokazuje njenu namjenu.
On each button there is a picture that shows its purpose.
Zelena tipka sa dvije strelice otvara vrata kada putnik želi izaći.
The green button with two arrows opens the doors when a passenger wants to get off.
Plave tipke imaju sliku kolica za bebe ili invalidskih kolica.
The blue buttons have a picture of a baby stroller or a wheelchair.
One govore vozaču da putniku treba više vremena za ulazak ili izlazak, pa vozač može spustiti rampu.
They tell the driver that a passenger needs more time to get on or off, so the driver can lower the ramp.
Mjesto za kolica je u sredini prvog i trećeg dijela tramvaja.
The space for strollers and wheelchairs is in the middle of the first and third parts of the tram.
Crvena tipka sa zvonom i riječju Alarm služi samo za hitne slučajeve.
The red button with a bell and the word Alarm is only for emergencies.
To je, na primjer, kada je nekome loše ili kada neko padne.
That is, for example, when someone feels unwell or when someone falls.
Vozač sjedi u kabini naprijed i često ne čuje putnike sa kraja tramvaja.
The driver sits in the cab at the front and often does not hear passengers from the end of the tram.
Zato ga crvena tipka odmah upozori da postoji problem.
That is why the red button immediately warns him that there is a problem.

title: Priča "Bunar" pobijedila na Susretima Zija Dizdarević
The story "Bunar" wins at the Zija Dizdarević Meetings
body: U Fojnici su završeni 42. Susreti Zija Dizdarević, književna manifestacija posvećena kratkoj priči.
The 42nd Zija Dizdarević Meetings, a literary event dedicated to the short story, ended in Fojnica.
Na kraju su podijeljene nagrade za najbolje priče.
At the end, awards were given for the best stories.
Prvu nagradu dobila je Azemina Krehić iz Zenice za priču "Bunar".
The first prize went to Azemina Krehić from Zenica for the story "Bunar" (The Well).
Žiri je pročitao 140 priča iz BiH i susjednih zemalja.
The jury read 140 stories from BiH and neighbouring countries.
Druga nagrada je otišla Radmili Stojadinović iz Požarevca, a treća Emini Mujkanović iz Tuzle.
The second prize went to Radmila Stojadinović from Požarevac, and the third to Emina Mujkanović from Tuzla.
Žiri je rekao da je bunar u pobjedničkoj priči simbol traume i skrivenih tajni.
The jury said that the well in the winning story is a symbol of trauma and hidden secrets.
Junakinja ne želi prodati porodičnu kuću, a tako prihvata svoju prošlost.
The heroine does not want to sell the family home, and in this way she accepts her past.
Nagrade su dobili i učenici za najbolje literarne radove.
Pupils also received awards for the best literary works.
Akademik Mirko Pejanović govorio je o Raifu Dizdareviću, bratu pisca, koji je nedavno preminuo.
Academician Mirko Pejanović spoke about Raif Dizdarević, the writer's brother, who recently died.
Predstavljena je i velika knjiga lirske poezije, na kojoj se radilo 40 godina.
A large book of lyric poetry, which was worked on for 40 years, was also presented.

title: Nova vlast u Srbiji želi ograničiti reality programe
Serbia's new government wants to limit reality shows
body: Studentska lista, koja je osvojila većinu u parlamentu Srbije, planira velike promjene na televiziji.
The Studentska lista, which won a majority in Serbia's parliament, is planning big changes on television.
Reality programi na nacionalnim televizijama trajali bi samo 45 minuta dnevno.
Reality shows on national TV channels would last only 45 minutes a day.
Ne bi se smjeli prikazivati prije 23 sata, piše britanski list The Telegraph.
They would not be allowed to be shown before 11 pm, writes the British newspaper The Telegraph.
Televizije bi morale odmah prekinuti program ako ima nasilja, prijetnji ili govora mržnje.
TV channels would have to stop the programme immediately if there is violence, threats or hate speech.
Pokret želi i radnu sedmicu od 4 dana, odnosno 32 sata, bez manje plate.
The movement also wants a working week of 4 days, that is 32 hours, without a lower salary.
Prekovremeni rad bi bio ograničen na 8 sati sedmično.
Overtime work would be limited to 8 hours a week.
Šefovi ne bi smjeli zvati radnike nakon radnog vremena.
Bosses would not be allowed to call workers after working hours.
Studentska lista je na izborima 25. oktobra dobila 140 od 250 mjesta u parlamentu.
The Studentska lista won 140 of 250 seats in parliament in the elections on 25 October.
Još nema jasnog kandidata za premijera.
There is still no clear candidate for prime minister.
Pokret je nastao nakon što se u novembru 2024. srušila nadstrešnica na stanici u Novom Sadu.
The movement was formed after a canopy collapsed at the station in Novi Sad in November 2024.
