Tada je poginulo 16 ljudi, a počeli su veliki protesti protiv korupcije.
16 people died then, and big protests against corruption began.

title: Stanivuković oštro kritikovao prijedlog Igora Dodika za premijera
Stanivuković sharply criticises the proposal of Igor Dodik as prime minister
body: Draško Stanivuković, predsjednik Pokreta Sigurna Srpska, oštro je reagovao na izbor Igora Dodika.
Draško Stanivuković, president of the Sigurna Srpska movement, reacted sharply to the choice of Igor Dodik.
Predsjednik RS-a Savo Minić predložio je sina Milorada Dodika za mandatara nove vlade.
RS President Savo Minić proposed Milorad Dodik's son as prime minister-designate of the new government.
Stanivuković se oglasio nekoliko sati nakon te vijesti.
Stanivuković spoke out a few hours after that news.
Napisao je da unuk dobija firmu, sin vladu, a sve to gleda djed.
He wrote that the grandson gets a company, the son a government, and the grandfather watches it all.
Minić je rekao da Igor Dodik ima znanje i iskustvo da vodi vladu.
Minić said that Igor Dodik has the knowledge and experience to lead a government.
Stanivuković je odgovorio da je to iskustvo u uzimanju novca iz budžeta građana.
Stanivuković replied that this is experience in taking money from the citizens' budget.
Prema njegovim riječima, Narodna skupština ne bi trebala potvrditi takav izbor.
In his words, the National Assembly should not confirm such a choice.
Mandatara mora potvrditi Narodna skupština Republike Srpske.
The prime minister-designate must be confirmed by the National Assembly of Republika Srpska.
Stanivuković je rekao da će njegova stranka biti protiv ovakve vlade.
Stanivuković said that his party will be against this kind of government.
Dodao je da Republika Srpska treba pripadati narodu, a ne jednom prezimenu.
He added that Republika Srpska should belong to the people, not to one surname.

title: Alajbegović se povrijedio na utakmici Juventusa i Venezije
Alajbegović gets injured in the Juventus–Venezia match
body: Bosanskohercegovački nogometaš Kerim Alajbegović povrijedio se u nedjelju na utakmici Juventusa protiv Venezije.
Bosnian-Herzegovinian footballer Kerim Alajbegović was injured on Sunday in Juventus's match against Venezia.
Utakmica 12. kola italijanske Serie A igrala se na domaćem stadionu Juventusa.
The 12th-round match of the Italian Serie A was played at Juventus's home stadium.
Alajbegović je bio u prvoj postavi, ali nije igrao do kraja.
Alajbegović was in the starting line-up, but he did not play to the end.
Povreda se desila u 35. minuti, a on je kratko izašao s terena zbog pomoći ljekara.
The injury happened in the 35th minute, and he briefly left the pitch for help from the doctors.
Nakon toga se vratio i igrao do kraja prvog poluvremena, iako je vidljivo šepao.
After that he came back and played until the end of the first half, although he was visibly limping.
Prvo poluvrijeme završilo je rezultatom 0:0.
The first half ended with a score of 0:0.
Trener Luciano Spalletti zamijenio ga je na poluvremenu, a umjesto njega je ušao Nick Woltemade.
Coach Luciano Spalletti replaced him at half-time, and Nick Woltemade came on instead of him.
Alajbegović je nakon povrede igrao još oko 10 minuta.
Alajbegović played about 10 more minutes after the injury.
Zato se vjeruje da povreda vjerovatno nije ozbiljna.
That is why it is believed that the injury is probably not serious.
Tačnu dijagnozu ipak treba čekati, jer će je dati ljekari kluba.
The exact diagnosis still has to be waited for, because the club's doctors will give it.

title: Šef Ferrarija ljut nakon sudara Hamiltona i Leclerca
Ferrari boss angry after Hamilton and Leclerc collide
body: Šef Ferrarija Fred Vasseur rekao je da je veoma ljut nakon sudara svojih vozača u Las Vegasu.
Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur said that he is very angry after his drivers collided in Las Vegas.
Charles Leclerc i Lewis Hamilton sudarili su se tokom utrke Formule 1, a Vasseur je rekao da je to neprihvatljivo.
Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton collided during the Formula 1 race, and Vasseur said that this is unacceptable.
Utrku je pobijedio Max Verstappen.
The race was won by Max Verstappen.
Sudar se desio u 38. od 50 krugova, a Hamilton se nakon udarca okrenuo na stazi.
The collision happened on lap 38 of 50, and Hamilton spun on the track after the hit.
Sudije su odlučile da je za sudar kriv samo Leclerc i dale mu kaznu od 10 sekundi.
The stewards decided that only Leclerc was to blame for the collision and gave him a 10-second penalty.
Hamilton je također dobio 10 sekundi kazne, ali zbog skraćivanja staze u borbi s Landom Norrisom.
Hamilton also got a 10-second penalty, but for cutting the track in a fight with Lando Norris.
Na kraju je Hamilton bio sedmi, a Leclerc deseti.
In the end Hamilton was seventh and Leclerc tenth.
Vasseur je rekao da je Leclerc dobio uputu da ne pretiče, ali je nije poslušao.
Vasseur said that Leclerc was told not to overtake, but he did not listen.
Tim je saopćio da je ovo drugi takav incident između njegovih vozača u 3 utrke.
The team said that this is the second such incident between its drivers in 3 races.
Vasseur će u ponedjeljak s timom razgovarati o mjerama koje bi Ferrari mogao preduzeti.
On Monday Vasseur will talk with the team about the measures that Ferrari could take.

title: Beogradski advokat traži da BiH izruči Milorada Dodika Srbiji
A Belgrade lawyer wants BiH to extradite Milorad Dodik to Serbia
body: Advokat iz Beograda Čedomir Stojković rekao je za BHRT da će nova vlast u Srbiji Milorada Dodika smatrati osumnjičenim.
Belgrade lawyer Čedomir Stojković told BHRT that the new government in Serbia will consider Milorad Dodik a suspect.
On očekuje da BiH izruči Dodika Srbiji kako bi mu se tamo sudilo za korupciju.
He expects BiH to extradite Dodik to Serbia so that he can be tried there for corruption.
Izručenje znači da jedna država preda osobu drugoj državi zbog suđenja.
Extradition means that one country hands a person over to another country for a trial.
Stojković tvrdi da je Dodik od građana Srbije kroz korupciju uzeo milione.
Stojković claims that Dodik took millions from the citizens of Serbia through corruption.
Dodik ima i državljanstvo Srbije, a Stojković kaže da je osumnjičen za mnoga krivična djela.
Dodik also has Serbian citizenship, and Stojković says that he is suspected of many criminal offences.
Smatra da nova vlast s njim neće praviti nikakve prljave dogovore.
He believes that the new government will not make any dirty deals with him.
Ako Dodik ostane u BiH, prva saradnja dvije države bila bi saradnja u krivičnim predmetima.
If Dodik stays in BiH, the first cooperation of the two countries would be cooperation in criminal cases.
Novi predsjednik skupštine Srbije Aleksandar Čupić izabran je 19. novembra.
The new speaker of the Serbian parliament, Aleksandar Čupić, was elected on 19 November.
Nova vlada Srbije trebala bi biti formirana u narednim sedmicama.
The new government of Serbia should be formed in the coming weeks.
Stojković je rekao i da očekuje kraj moći Aleksandra Vučića najkasnije do januara.
Stojković also said that he expects the end of Aleksandar Vučić's power by January at the latest.

title: Igor Dodik prihvatio mandat i najavio saradnju sa Srbijom
Igor Dodik accepts the mandate and announces cooperation with Serbia
body: Igor Dodik je u nedjelju prihvatio prijedlog da bude mandatar nove Vlade Republike Srpske.
On Sunday Igor Dodik accepted the proposal to be the prime minister-designate of the new Government of Republika Srpska.
Predložio ga je predsjednik RS-a Savo Minić, a podršku mu je dao i SNSD.
He was proposed by RS President Savo Minić, and the SNSD also gave him its support.
Dodik je rekao da mandat prihvata s punom odgovornošću.
Dodik said that he accepts the mandate with full responsibility.
Prema njegovim riječima, saradnja sa Srbijom imat će posebno mjesto u radu vlade.
In his words, cooperation with Serbia will have a special place in the government's work.
Želi dobru saradnju s budućom vladom Srbije, koju će voditi Studentska lista.
He wants good cooperation with the future government of Serbia, which will be led by the Studentska lista.
Rekao je i da RS podržava ulazak u Evropsku uniju samo ako se poštuju njeni interesi.
He also said that RS supports joining the European Union only if its interests are respected.
Građani žele stabilne plate i penzije, bolje zdravstvo i školstvo, a vlada će na tome raditi od prvog dana.
Citizens want stable salaries and pensions, better healthcare and schools, and the government will work on that from the first day.
Dodik je rekao da svi žele mijenjati svijet, ali niko ne želi mijenjati sebe.
Dodik said that everyone wants to change the world, but nobody wants to change themselves.
Dodao je da će donositi odluke, čak i kada su bolne.
He added that he will make decisions, even when they are painful.
Sada mora Narodnoj skupštini predstaviti program i sastav vlade.
Now he must present the programme and the composition of the government to the National Assembly.
Vlada će biti izabrana ako za nju glasa većina svih poslanika, a mandat traje 4 godine.
The government will be elected if a majority of all deputies vote for it, and the mandate lasts 4 years.

title: Igor Dodik zvanično predložen za premijera Republike Srpske
Igor Dodik officially proposed as prime minister of Republika Srpska
body: Predsjednik Republike Srpske Savo Minić predložio je u nedjelju Igora Dodika za mandatara nove vlade.
On Sunday the President of Republika Srpska Savo Minić proposed Igor Dodik as prime minister-designate of the new government.
Odluku je donio nakon razgovora s partnerima iz koalicije u Banjoj Luci.
He made the decision after talks with coalition partners in Banja Luka.
Igor Dodik je sin lidera SNSD-a Milorada Dodika i organizacioni sekretar te stranke.
Igor Dodik is the son of SNSD leader Milorad Dodik and the party's organisational secretary.
Minić je na konferenciji za medije rekao da Dodik ima znanje i iskustvo da vodi vladu.
At a press conference Minić said that Dodik has the knowledge and experience to lead the government.
Dodao je da bi on bio najmlađi premijer u historiji RS-a.
He added that he would be the youngest prime minister in the history of RS.
Na oktobarskim izborima Dodik je prvi put bio kandidat za Narodnu skupštinu.
In the October elections Dodik was a candidate for the National Assembly for the first time.
Prema preliminarnim rezultatima, dobio je najviše ličnih glasova, njih 18.104.
According to preliminary results, he won the most personal votes, 18,104 of them.
Drugi je bio Draško Stanivuković sa 15.570 glasova.
Second was Draško Stanivuković with 15,570 votes.
Lideri Socijalističke partije, DNS-a i NPS-a rekli su da podržavaju Minićev izbor.
The leaders of the Socialist Party, the DNS and the NPS said that they support Minić's choice.
Narodna skupština sada mora potvrditi prijedlog prije nego što vlada počne raditi.
The National Assembly now has to confirm the proposal before the government starts working.

title: Zabranjeno pušenje drugi put oduševilo publiku u Zagrebu
Zabranjeno pušenje thrills the audience in Zagreb for the second time
body: Zabranjeno pušenje održalo je u subotu drugi rasprodani akustični koncert u dvorani Lisinski u Zagrebu.
On Saturday Zabranjeno pušenje held a second sold-out acoustic concert in the Lisinski hall in Zagreb.
Bend je nastupio kao Neuštekani, što je naziv njihovog akustičnog projekta koji traje oko 2 godine.
The band performed as Neuštekani, which is the name of their acoustic project that has been going for about 2 years.
Publika je pjevala i pljeskala, a na kraju je ustala sa sjedišta.
The audience sang and clapped, and in the end it stood up from its seats.
Koncert je počeo pjesmom „Halid umjesto Halida“, posvećenom Halidu Bešliću, koji bi dan ranije imao rođendan.
The concert began with the song "Halid umjesto Halida", dedicated to Halid Bešlić, who would have had his birthday the day before.
Svirali su i poznate pjesme kao što su „Lijepa Alma“, „Bog vozi Mercedes“ i „Boško i Admira“.
They also played well-known songs such as "Lijepa Alma", "Bog vozi Mercedes" and "Boško i Admira".
Sredinom koncerta pridružio im se gudački kvartet, mala grupa od 4 muzičara sa violinama i violončelom.
In the middle of the concert they were joined by a string quartet, a small group of 4 musicians with violins and a cello.
Koncert je trajao skoro 3 sata.
The concert lasted almost 3 hours.
Sejo Sexon se našalio da kvartet bolje pristaje Lisinskom od samog benda.
Sejo Sexon joked that the quartet suits Lisinski better than the band itself.
Treći koncert u Lisinskom bit će 28. januara 2027., ponovo s kvartetom.
The third concert in Lisinski will be on 28 January 2027, again with the quartet.
Prije toga Neuštekani će 4. i 5. decembra svirati u Sarajevu, u BKC-u.
Before that Neuštekani will play in Sarajevo, at the BKC, on 4 and 5 December.

title: Branko Blanuša dao ostavku na mjesto predsjednika SDS-a
Branko Blanuša resigns as president of the SDS
body: Branko Blanuša podnio je u nedjelju ostavku na mjesto predsjednika Srpske demokratske stranke.
On Sunday Branko Blanuša resigned from the post of president of the Serb Democratic Party.
Razloge je objasnio u pismu članovima i simpatizerima stranke.
He explained the reasons in a letter to party members and supporters.
Nakon lošeg rezultata na oktobarskim izborima, mnogi u SDS-u tražili su njegovu ostavku.
After the poor result in the October elections, many in the SDS asked for his resignation.
Blanuša je napisao da u stranci već dugo nema disciplinske komisije, pa svako radi šta hoće.
Blanuša wrote that for a long time the party has had no disciplinary commission, so everyone does as they please.
Kaže da se odluke stranačkih organa ne poštuju, a funkcioneri se napadaju preko medija.
He says that the decisions of party bodies are not respected, and officials attack each other through the media.
Statut stranke predsjedniku ne daje pravo da stvarno vodi stranku.
The party statute does not give the president the right to really lead the party.
Kao razlog je naveo i zdravlje, jer mu je prošla godina mnogo naštetila.
He also gave his health as a reason, because the past year harmed it a lot.
Početkom novembra Blanuša je govorio da neće dati ostavku, ali se sada predomislio.
At the beginning of November Blanuša said that he would not resign, but now he has changed his mind.
Rekao je da SDS ima mnogo dobrih ljudi i da želi da stranka brzo izađe iz krize.
He said that the SDS has many good people and that he wants the party to get out of the crisis quickly.
Još se ne zna ko bi ga mogao zamijeniti, a neki članovi žele povratak Milana Miličevića.
It is not yet known who could replace him, and some members want the return of Milan Miličević.

title: Zašto i zdravi muškarci trebaju redovno raditi nalaze
Why healthy men should also get regular check-ups
body: Mnogi muškarci ne idu na kontrole jer se osjećaju dobro i misle da nikad nisu bolesni.
Many men do not go for check-ups because they feel good and think they are never ill.
Doktorica Vesna Gluvić-Čelić iz laboratorije Prolab u Banjoj Luci kaže da muškarci u laboratoriju često dolaze prekasno.
Doctor Vesna Gluvić-Čelić from the Prolab laboratory in Banja Luka says that men often come to the laboratory too late.
U novembru kampanja Movember u cijelom svijetu poziva muškarce da se provjere i bez simptoma.
In November the Movember campaign around the world calls on men to get checked even without symptoms.
Prema njenim riječima, mnogi misle da muškarac mora sve izdržati i da su kontrole za žene.
In her words, many think that a man must endure everything and that check-ups are for women.
Visok šećer, masnoće u krvi i problemi s prostatom mogu se godinama razvijati bez bolova.
High sugar, fats in the blood and prostate problems can develop for years without pain.
U Kantonu Sarajevo planirano je 2.800 pregleda prostate, a do početka novembra urađeno je 422.
In Sarajevo Canton 2,800 prostate exams were planned, and by the start of November 422 had been done.
Kod 33 muškarca nalaz je bio pozitivan.
For 33 men the result was positive.
Doktorica savjetuje da se osnovni nalazi rade barem jednom godišnje, a PSA test nakon 50. godine.
The doctor advises that basic tests be done at least once a year, and the PSA test after the age of 50.
Ako u porodici ima raka prostate, dijabetesa ili infarkta, kontrole bi trebalo raditi 2 puta godišnje.
If there is prostate cancer, diabetes or heart attack in the family, check-ups should be done twice a year.
Krv se daje ujutro, na prazan stomak, a dan ranije treba izbjegavati alkohol i teške obroke.
Blood is given in the morning on an empty stomach, and the day before one should avoid alcohol and heavy meals.

title: Upozorenje zbog jakog juga i obilne kiše u BiH
Warning over strong south wind and heavy rain in BiH
body: Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod izdao je upozorenje zbog jakog vjetra i obilne kiše za veći dio BiH.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute issued a warning about strong wind and heavy rain for most of BiH.
Upozorenje važi za nedjelju, 22. novembra, a posebno za jug zemlje.
The warning applies to Sunday, 22 November, and especially to the south of the country.
Kiša dolazi sa zapada u drugoj polovini dana, a u Sarajevu se očekuje popodne.
The rain is coming from the west in the second half of the day, and it is expected in Sarajevo in the afternoon.
Od podneva puše jugo, topli južni vjetar, s udarima od 40 do 60 kilometara na sat.
From noon the jugo, a warm south wind, is blowing with gusts of 40 to 60 kilometres per hour.
U regiji Mostara moglo bi pasti od 30 do 60 litara kiše po metru kvadratnom, a lokalno i do 70.
In the Mostar region 30 to 60 litres of rain per square metre could fall, and locally up to 70.
Dnevna temperatura bit će od 8 do 14, a na jugu do 16 stepeni.
The daytime temperature will be from 8 to 14, and in the south up to 16 degrees.
Zavod upozorava na moguće poplave i otežanu vožnju zbog vode na cestama.
The institute warns of possible floods and difficult driving because of water on the roads.
Najviše kiše past će u noći na ponedjeljak, kada su mogući i grmljavina i olujni udari vjetra.
The most rain will fall in the night before Monday, when thunderstorms and storm gusts of wind are also possible.
Zbog hladnijeg zraka kiša će na planinama preći u snijeg, a slab snijeg moguć je i u nižim krajevima.
Because of colder air the rain will turn into snow in the mountains, and light snow is also possible in lower areas.
U ponedjeljak popodne padavine prestaju, a od srijede stiže novi ciklon sa snijegom.
On Monday afternoon the precipitation stops, and from Wednesday a new cyclone arrives with snow.

title: Dvije letjelice nakon 8 godina stigle u orbitu Merkura
Two spacecraft reach Mercury's orbit after 8 years
body: Dvije robotske letjelice misije BepiColombo ušle su u subotu u orbitu oko planete Merkur.
On Saturday two robotic spacecraft of the BepiColombo mission entered orbit around the planet Mercury.
Na put su krenule 2018. godine i putovale su 8 godina.
They set off in 2018 and travelled for 8 years.
Misiju zajedno vode Evropska svemirska agencija ESA i japanska agencija JAXA.
The mission is run jointly by the European Space Agency ESA and the Japanese agency JAXA.
Projekt je koštao oko 2 milijarde dolara.
The project cost about 2 billion dollars.
Letjelice su usporile motorima, pa ih je slaba gravitacija Merkura mogla uhvatiti.
The spacecraft slowed down with their engines, so Mercury's weak gravity could capture them.
Kontrolori u Njemačkoj, udaljenoj oko 152 miliona kilometara, trebali su nekoliko sati da to potvrde.
Controllers in Germany, about 152 million kilometres away, needed several hours to confirm it.
Na putu su prešle više od 10 milijardi kilometara, a usput su prošle pored Zemlje, Venere i Merkura.
On the way they covered more than 10 billion kilometres, and along the way they passed by Earth, Venus and Mercury.
Ovo je tek treća letjelica koja je posjetila Merkur i prva nakon više od 10 godina.
This is only the third spacecraft to visit Mercury and the first in more than 10 years.
Sljedećeg mjeseca letjelice će se razdvojiti i proučavati planetu s različitih visina.
Next month the spacecraft will separate and study the planet from different heights.
Naučnici očekuju prve nove podatke na proljeće, iako temperatura na površini može biti preko 427 stepeni.
Scientists expect the first new data in spring, although the temperature on the surface can be over 427 degrees.

title: Milan želi dovesti Brunu Fernandesa i Ermedina Demirovića
Milan wants to bring in Bruno Fernandes and Ermedin Demirović
body: Italijanski mediji pišu da Milan u januaru želi dovesti dva velika pojačanja.
Italian media write that Milan wants to bring in two big signings in January.
Na listi su kapiten Manchester Uniteda Bruno Fernandes i reprezentativac BiH Ermedin Demirović.
On the list are Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes and Bosnia and Herzegovina international Ermedin Demirović.
Transfere priprema Markus Krösche, koji još nije zvanično preuzeo mjesto sportskog direktora Milana.
The transfers are being prepared by Markus Krösche, who has not yet officially taken the post of Milan's sporting director.
Ugovor Fernandesa s Unitedom ističe u ljeto, ali klub ga može produžiti za još jednu godinu.
Fernandes's contract with United expires in the summer, but the club can extend it by one more year.
Novi trener Uniteda Mauricio Pochettino rekao je da je Bruno izuzetno važan igrač.
United's new coach Mauricio Pochettino said that Bruno is an extremely important player.
Demirović je postao glavna meta Milana za napad jer je mnogo jeftiniji od drugih napadača.
Demirović has become Milan's main target for the attack because he is much cheaper than other strikers.
On ima ugovor sa Stuttgartom do 2028. godine, a ove sezone je dao 5 golova u Bundesligi i 4 u Ligi prvaka.
He has a contract with Stuttgart until 2028, and this season he has scored 5 goals in the Bundesliga and 4 in the Champions League.
U Milanu vjeruju da bi mogli dogovoriti dobru cijenu, jer Krösche ima dobre veze u Njemačkoj.
At Milan they believe that they could agree a good price, because Krösche has good connections in Germany.
Galatasaray je prošlog ljeta također želio Demirovića i još nije odustao.
Galatasaray also wanted Demirović last summer and has not given up yet.
Za napadača od 28 godina zanimaju se i neki klubovi iz Premier lige.
Some Premier League clubs are also interested in the 28-year-old striker.

title: Verstappen pobijedio u Las Vegasu, loša utrka za Ferrari
Verstappen won in Las Vegas, a bad race for Ferrari
body: Max Verstappen iz Red Bulla pobijedio je na Velikoj nagradi Las Vegasa.
Max Verstappen of Red Bull won the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
To je bila 21. utrka ove sezone Formule 1.
It was the 21st race of this Formula 1 season.
Drugo mjesto osvojio je Lando Norris, a treći je bio Oscar Piastri, obojica iz McLarena.
Second place went to Lando Norris, and third was Oscar Piastri, both from McLaren.
Verstappen je krenuo s prvog mjesta jer je najbrži u kvalifikacijama, Kimi Antonelli, kažnjen zbog promjene motora.
Verstappen started from first place because the fastest in qualifying, Kimi Antonelli, was penalised for an engine change.
Utrka je imala mnogo preticanja i nekoliko ulazaka sigurnosnog automobila.
The race had a lot of overtaking and several safety car periods.
Antonelli je drugo mjesto izgubio u posljednjim trenucima, a George Russell je odustao dva kruga prije kraja.
Antonelli lost second place in the final moments, and George Russell retired two laps before the end.
Vozači Ferrarija Lewis Hamilton i Charles Leclerc sudarili su se u 38. krugu i obojica su kažnjena.
Ferrari drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided on lap 38 and both were penalised.
Utrka nije bila važna za borbu za titulu.
The race was not important for the fight for the title.
Antonelli je početkom novembra u Meksiku postao najmlađi prvak u historiji s 20 godina, a Mercedes je već osvojio titulu među timovima.
At the start of November in Mexico, Antonelli became the youngest champion in history at 20, and Mercedes has already won the title among the teams.
Za Verstappena je to četvrta pobjeda ove sezone, a do kraja su ostale još utrke u Kataru i Abu Dhabiju.
For Verstappen it is his fourth win this season, and races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi are still left until the end.

title: Theresa May kritikuje ideju o povratku Britanije u EU
Theresa May criticises the idea of Britain returning to the EU
body: Bivša britanska premijerka Theresa May oštro je kritikovala sadašnjeg premijera Andyja Burnhama.
Former British Prime Minister Theresa May sharply criticised the current Prime Minister Andy Burnham.
U intervjuu za BBC rekla je da je zaprepaštena jer Burnham razmišlja o povratku u Evropsku uniju.
In an interview with the BBC she said that she is shocked because Burnham is thinking about returning to the European Union.
Intervju se emituje u nedjelju u emisiji Laure Kuenssberg.
The interview is broadcast on Sunday in Laura Kuenssberg's programme.
Burnham je na samitu EU u Briselu rekao da želi razmijeniti ideje o budućim odnosima s Unijom.
At the EU summit in Brussels, Burnham said that he wants to exchange ideas about future relations with the Union.
Sedmicu ranije u Londonu je izjavio da Brexit nije uspio.
A week earlier in London he stated that Brexit had failed.
May je poručila da je Brexit gotov i da ga treba prihvatiti i ići dalje.
May said that Brexit is over and that it should be accepted and people should move on.
Prema njenim riječima, Burnham ljudima govori da su pogrešno glasali i da trebaju glasati ponovo.
According to her, Burnham is telling people that they voted wrongly and that they should vote again.
May je bila premijerka od 2016. do 2019. godine.
May was Prime Minister from 2016 to 2019.
Prije referenduma podržavala je ostanak u EU, ali je kao premijerka tri godine pregovarala o izlasku.
Before the referendum she supported staying in the EU, but as Prime Minister she negotiated the exit for three years.
Rekla je da bi vlada trebala jačati ekonomiju, sigurnost i prilike za građane.
She said that the government should strengthen the economy, security and opportunities for citizens.

title: Sacramento u posljednjim sekundama pobijedio Boston
Sacramento beat Boston in the final seconds
body: Košarkaši Sacramento Kingsa pobijedili su Boston Celticse rezultatom 97:96 u NBA ligi.
The Sacramento Kings basketball players beat the Boston Celtics 97-96 in the NBA.
Odlučujući koš dao je Keegan Murray oko 5 sekundi prije kraja, nakon što je uhvatio odbijenu loptu.
The deciding basket was scored by Keegan Murray about 5 seconds before the end, after he caught a rebound.
Payton Pritchard je u posljednjem napadu Bostona promašio šut za tri poena.
Payton Pritchard missed a three-point shot in Boston's last attack.
Boston je na poluvremenu vodio 13 poena, ali je u trećoj četvrtini izgubio 35:13.
Boston led by 13 points at half-time, but lost the third quarter 35-13.
U toj četvrtini promašio je svih 13 šuteva za tri poena.
In that quarter it missed all 13 three-point shots.
Najbolji kod Sacramenta bio je Darius Acuff s 21 poenom, a kod Bostona Paul George s 19 poena.
The best for Sacramento was Darius Acuff with 21 points, and for Boston Paul George with 19 points.
Reprezentativac BiH Luka Garza igrao je 17 minuta i imao 5 poena i 5 skokova.
Bosnia and Herzegovina international Luka Garza played 17 minutes and had 5 points and 5 rebounds.
Ovo je tek druga pobjeda Sacramenta u sezoni i prva na domaćem terenu.
This is only Sacramento's second win of the season and the first on home court.
Boston je igrao bez Jaysona Tatuma, Derricka Whitea i Mitchella Robinsona.
Boston played without Jayson Tatum, Derrick White and Mitchell Robinson.
Celticsi su izgubili treću utakmicu zaredom i sada imaju 11 pobjeda i 5 poraza.
The Celtics lost their third game in a row and now have 11 wins and 5 losses.

title: Zapaljeni ruski teretni brod otplutao u finske vode
Burning Russian cargo ship drifted into Finnish waters
body: Ruski teretni brod Sparta II zapalio se u subotu u Baltičkom moru nakon napada dronovima.
The Russian cargo ship Sparta II caught fire on Saturday in the Baltic Sea after a drone attack.
Brod je napadnut u međunarodnim vodama zapadno od ruskog ostrva Gogland, a zatim je otplutao u finske vode.
The ship was attacked in international waters west of the Russian island of Gogland, and then it drifted into Finnish waters.
Finska vojska je rekla da iza napada vjerovatno stoji Ukrajina.
The Finnish army said that Ukraine is probably behind the attack.
Brod je plovio prema Kalinjingradu, a sada je usidren u finskim vodama.
The ship was sailing towards Kaliningrad, and now it is anchored in Finnish waters.
Svih 16 članova posade napustilo je brod u čamcima za spašavanje i vraća se u Rusiju.
All 16 crew members left the ship in lifeboats and are returning to Russia.
Nije poznato šta je brod prevozio, ali vlasti ne isključuju vojni teret.
It is not known what the ship was carrying, but the authorities do not rule out military cargo.
Sjedinjene Američke Države ranije su uvele sankcije ovom brodu.
The United States earlier imposed sanctions on this ship.
Finska je privremeno ograničila saobraćaj u zraku i na moru u istočnom dijelu Finskog zaljeva.
Finland temporarily restricted air and sea traffic in the eastern part of the Gulf of Finland.
Finski premijer Petteri Orpo napisao je da se rat prelijeva u susjedna područja.
Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo wrote that the war is spilling over into neighbouring areas.
Švedski avioni pod finskom komandom pomogli su u zaštiti finskog teritorija, a Estonija je poslala brod da pomogne u gašenju požara.
Swedish planes under Finnish command helped protect Finnish territory, and Estonia sent a ship to help put out the fire.
Ruski guverner je rekao da su dva drona napala brod i da je preko noći oboreno 80 dronova iznad regije.
A Russian governor said that two drones attacked the ship and that 80 drones were shot down over the region overnight.
